Filipinet kanë një qeveri [[Demokracia|demokratike]], një [[Republika|republikë]] kushtetuese me [[Sistemi presidencial|sistem presidencial]].<ref name="Rose-Ackerman">{{cite journal |last1=Rose-Ackerman |first1=Susan |last2=Desierto |first2=Diane A. |last3=Volosin |first3=Natalia |date=2011 |title=Hyper-Presidentialism: Separation of Powers without Checks and Balances in Argentina and Philippines |url=https://openyls.law.yale.edu/bitstream/handle/20.500.13051/3618/29BerkeleyJIntlL246.pdf?sequence=2&isAllowed=y |journal=Berkeley Journal of International Law |publisher=UC Berkeley School of Law |volume=29 |oclc=8092527577 |pages=246–333 |author-link1=Susan Rose-Ackerman |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220126072232/https://openyls.law.yale.edu/bitstream/handle/20.500.13051/3618/29BerkeleyJIntlL246.pdf?sequence=2&isAllowed=y |archive-date=2022-01-26 |language=en}}</ref> [[Kreu i shtetit|Presidenti]] është [[Kreu i qeverisë|kreu i shtetit dhe i qeverisë]],<ref name="Banlaoi-2009"/> si dhe [[Komandanti i përgjithshëm|komandant i përgjithshëm]] i [[Forcat e Armatosura të Filipineve|forcave të armatosura]].<ref name="Rose-Ackerman" /> Presidenti [[Zgjedhjet presidenciale në Filipine|zgjidhet]] drejtpërdrejt nga [[Ligji i shtetësisë filipinase|qytetarët e Filipineve]] për një mandat gjashtëvjeçar.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Teehankee |first1=Julio C. |author-link1=Julio C. Teehankee |last2=Thompson |first2=Mark R. |date=October 2016 |title=The Vote in the Philippines: Electing A Strongman |url=https://www.journalofdemocracy.org/articles/the-vote-in-the-philippines-electing-a-strongman/ |journal=Journal of Democracy |publisher=Johns Hopkins University Press |volume=27 |issue=4 |issn=1086-3214 |pages=124–134 |doi=10.1353/jod.2016.0068 |author-link2=Mark R. Thompson |access-date=2020-12-30 |archive-date=2021-01-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210117011258/https://www.journalofdemocracy.org/articles/the-vote-in-the-philippines-electing-a-strongman/ |url-status=live|url-access=subscription |language=en}}</ref> [[Zëvendëspresidenti i Filipineve|Zëvendëspresidenti]], i cili mund të shërbejë deri në dy mandate radhazi gjashtëvjeçare, zgjidhet veçmas nga presidenti.<ref name="Lazo">{{cite book |last1=Lazo |first1=Ricardo S. |title=Philippine Governance and the 1987 Constitution |date=2009 |publisher=Rex Bookstore, Inc. |isbn=978-971-23-4546-3 |edition=2006 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=fMszAErMRKYC |language=en}}</ref> Kjo do të thotë se presidenti dhe zëvendëspresidenti mund t’u përkasin partive të ndryshme politike. Presidenti emëron dhe drejton [[Kabineti i Filipineve|kabinetin]], si dhe zyrtarët e agjencive e institucioneve të ndryshme të qeverisë kombëtare.<ref name="Lazo-2009">{{cite book |last=Lazo |first=Ricardo S. Jr. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=fMszAErMRKYC |title=Philippine Governance and the 1987 Constitution |date=2009 |publisher=REX Book Store, Inc. |location=Manila, Philippines |isbn=978-971-23-4546-3 |edition=2006 |access-date=2020-12-30 |archive-date=2024-02-03 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240203074324/https://books.google.com/books?id=fMszAErMRKYC |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref>{{rp|page={{plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=fMszAErMRKYC&pg=213|name=213–214}}}} [[Dydhomësia|Kongresi]] përbëhet nga [[Senati i Filipineve|Senati]] ([[Dhoma e sipërme|dhoma e sipërme]], anëtarët e të cilit zgjidhen për një mandat gjashtëvjeçar) dhe [[Dhoma e Përfaqësuesve e Filipineve|Dhoma e Përfaqësuesve]] ([[Dhoma e ulët|dhoma e ulët]], anëtarët e së cilës zgjidhen për një mandat trevjeçar).<ref>{{cite report |title=Carter Center Limited Mission to the May 2010 Elections in the Philippines Final Report |url=https://www.cartercenter.org/resources/pdfs/news/peace_publications/election_reports/philippines-may%202010-elections-finalrpt.pdf |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120323212046/https://www.cartercenter.org/resources/pdfs/news/peace_publications/election_reports/philippines-may%202010-elections-finalrpt.pdf |archive-date=2012-03-23 |publisher=The Carter Center |location=Atlanta, Ga. |oclc=733049273 |language=en}}</ref>

Senatorët zgjidhen në të gjithë vendin,<ref name="CarterCenterOrg-2010-Elections">{{cite report |title=Carter Center Limited Mission to the May 2010 Elections in the Philippines Final Report |url=https://www.cartercenter.org/resources/pdfs/news/peace_publications/election_reports/philippines-may%202010-elections-finalrpt.pdf |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120323212046/https://www.cartercenter.org/resources/pdfs/news/peace_publications/election_reports/philippines-may%202010-elections-finalrpt.pdf |archive-date=March 23, 2012 |publisher=[[The Carter Center]] |location=Atlanta, Ga. |oclc=733049273}}</ref> ndërsa përfaqësuesit zgjidhen nga [[Rrethet zgjedhore të Filipineve|rrethet zgjedhore]] dhe [[Përfaqësimi me lista partiake në Dhomën e Përfaqësuesve të Filipineve|listat partiake]].<ref name="Lazo-2009" />{{rp|pages={{plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=fMszAErMRKYC&pg=162|name=162–163}}}}
Autoriteti gjyqësor i është besuar [[Gjykata Supreme e Filipineve|Gjykatës Supreme]], e përbërë nga një {{ill|Kryetari i Gjykatës Supreme të Filipineve|en|Chief Justice of the Philippines}} dhe katërmbëdhjetë {{ill|gjyqtarë të asociuar të Gjykatës Supreme të Filipineve|en|Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of the Philippines}},<ref>{{Cite book |date=March 2001 |editor-last=Pangalangan |editor-first=Raul C. |title=The Philippine Judicial System |url=https://aboutphilippines.org/doc-pdf-ppt-etc/05_Philippine-Judicial-System.pdf |series=Asian Law Series |publisher=Institute of Developing Economies |location=Chiba, Japan |oclc=862953657 |pages=6, 39 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210305185845/https://aboutphilippines.org/doc-pdf-ppt-etc/05_Philippine-Judicial-System.pdf |archive-date=2021-03-05 |author-link1=Raul Pangalangan |language=en}}</ref> të cilët emërohen nga presidenti nga kandidaturat e paraqitura nga {{ill|Këshilli Gjyqësor dhe i Avokatisë|en|Judicial and Bar Council}}.<ref name="Rose-Ackerman" />

{{ill|Përpjekjet për reformën kushtetuese në Filipine|en|Constitutional reform in the Philippines}} për ta shndërruar qeverisjen në një qeverisje federale, [[Njëdhomësia|njëdhomëshe]] ose me [[Sistemi kuvendor|sistem kuvendor]] janë bërë që nga administrata e Ramosit.<ref>{{Cite book |editor-last1=He |editor-first1=Baogang |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=nXf9C2xbKsYC |title=Federalism in Asia |editor-last2=Galligan |editor-first2=Brian |editor-last3=Inoguchi |editor-first3=Takashi |date=January 2009 |publisher=Edward Elgar Publishing |location=Cheltenham, England |isbn=978-1-84720-702-9 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=nXf9C2xbKsYC&pg=PA176 176] |access-date=2020-09-28 |archive-date=2023-02-12 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230212201623/https://books.google.com/books?id=nXf9C2xbKsYC |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> Politika filipinase priret të dominohet nga familje të njohura, si dinastitë politike ose personazhet e famshëm,<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=David |first1=Clarissa C. |last2=Atun |first2=Jenna Mae L. |title=Celebrity Politics: Correlates of Voting for Celebrities in Philippine Presidential Elections |journal=Social Science Diliman |date=December 2015 |volume=11 |issue=2 |pages=1–2, 16–17 |url=http://journals.upd.edu.ph/index.php/socialsciencediliman/article/download/4796/4328 |access-date=2023-05-10 |publisher=University of the Philippines |language=en |issn=1655-1524 |oclc=8539228072 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170925043652/http://journals.upd.edu.ph/index.php/socialsciencediliman/article/download/4796/4328 |archive-date=2017-09-25}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=David |first1=Clarissa C. |last2=San Pascual |first2=Ma. Rosel S. |date=2016-12-21 |title=Predicting vote choice for celebrity and political dynasty candidates in Philippine national elections |url=https://brill.com/view/journals/ppsj/37/2/article-p82_1.xml |journal=Philippine Political Science Journal |publisher=Philippine Political Science Association |volume=37 |issue=2 |pages=82–93 |doi=10.1080/01154451.2016.1198076 |s2cid=156251503 |access-date=2021-01-01 |archive-date=2021-04-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210417044320/https://brill.com/view/journals/ppsj/37/2/article-p82_1.xml |url-status=live |url-access=subscription |language=en}}</ref> ndërsa kalimi nga një parti në tjetrën është praktikë e përhapur.<ref>{{Cite book |editor-last1=Hicken |editor-first1=Allen |editor-last2=Kuhonta |editor-first2=Erik Martinez |title=Party System Institutionalization in Asia: Democracies, Autocracies, and the Shadows of the Past |date=2015 |publisher=Cambridge University Press |location=New York |isbn=978-1-107-04157-8 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=GZmiBQAAQBAJ&pg=PA316 316] |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=GZmiBQAAQBAJ |access-date=2024-08-15 |language=en}}</ref> Korrupsioni është i përhapur,<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Robles |first=Alan C. |date=July–August 2008 |title=Civil service reform: Whose service? Jr. |date=June 2011 |title=Middle East Security Issues and Implications for the Philippines |journal=Indian Journal of Asian Affairs |volume=24 |issue=1/2 |issn=0970-6402 |pages=49–61 |jstor=41950511 |language=en}}</ref> janë shprehur shqetësime për dhunën në familje dhe luftën që prekin rreth 2,5&nbsp;milionë punëtorët filipinas jashtë vendit në rajon.<ref>{{cite report |last1=Jabar |first1=Melvin |last2=Jesperson |first2=Sasha |title=Analysis of labour migrants' vulnerabilities to trafficking in persons and labour exploitation in the Philippines |series=Trafficking in persons and labour exploitation: A political economy analysis |date=March 2024 |publisher=ODI |location=London |pages=37–38, 46, 51 |url=https://odi.cdn.ngo/media/documents/Analysis_of_labour_migrants_vulnerabilities_to_TIP_and_labour_exploitation_in__rVyk7Ub.pdf |access-date=August 14, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240330213250/https://odi.cdn.ngo/media/documents/Analysis_of_labour_migrants_vulnerabilities_to_TIP_and_labour_exploitation_in__rVyk7Ub.pdf |archive-date=March 30, 2024 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|last=Tarrazona |first=Noel T. |date=October 17, 2018 |title=For skilled Filipinos, Middle East remains a career destination |work=Al Arabiya |url=https://english.alarabiya.net/en/features/2018/10/17/For-skilled-Filipinos-Middle-East-continues-to-remain-a-career-destination |access-date=August 7, 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201002122006/https://english.alarabiya.net/en/features/2018/10/17/For-skilled-Filipinos-Middle-East-continues-to-remain-a-career-destination |archive-date=October 2, 2020 |language=en}}</ref>

Filipinet kanë pretendime mbi {{ill|Ishujt Spratly|en|Spratly Islands}} që mbivendosen me pretendimet e Kinës, Malajzisë, Tajvanit dhe Vietnamit.<ref>{{cite report |last1=Joyner |first1=Christopher C. |editor-last1=Singh |editor-first1=Ranjeet K. |title=Investigating Confidence-Building Measures in the Asia-Pacific Region |date=1999 |publisher=Stimson Center |page=56 |chapter=The Spratly Islands Dispute in the South China Sea: Problems, Policies, and Prospects for Diplomatic Accommodation |author-link1=Christopher C. Joyner |jstor=resrep10935.8 |jstor-access=free |language=en}}</ref> Më i madhi i ishujve që kontrollon Filipinet është ishulli Thitu, ku ndodhet qyteti më i vogël i Filipineve, Kalayaan.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|last=Pitlo |first=Lucio Blanco III |date=May 27, 2020 |title=Philippines bolsters posture in South China Sea after navy ship docks at new Spratly Islands port |work=South China Morning Post |url=https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/opinion/article/3086253/philippines-bolsters-posture-south-china-sea-after-navy-ship |access-date=August 7, 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200527030224/https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/opinion/article/3086253/philippines-bolsters-posture-south-china-sea-after-navy-ship |archive-date=May 27, 2020 |language=en}}</ref> Përplasja e vitit 2012 në cekëtinën Scarborough, pasi Kina e mori atë nga Filipinet, çoi në një çështje arbitrazhi ndërkombëtar,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=De Castro |first1=Renato Cruz |title=The Limits of Intergovernmentalism: The Philippines' Changing Strategy in the South China Sea Dispute and Its Impact on the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) |journal=Journal of Current Southeast Asian Affairs |date=December 2020 |volume=39 |issue=3 |pages=338–346 |doi=10.1177/1868103420935562 |publisher=SAGE Publishing |doi-access=free |language=en}}</ref> të cilën Filipinet e fituan përfundimisht;<ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|date=July 12, 2016 |title=PH wins maritime arbitration case vs. China |publisher=CNN Philippines |url=https://www.cnnphilippines.com/news/2016/07/12/PH-wins-maritime-arbitration-case-vs-China.html |access-date=November 11, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160713171115/https://www.cnnphilippines.com/news/2016/07/12/PH-wins-maritime-arbitration-case-vs-China.html |archive-date=July 13, 2016 |language=en}}</ref> Kina e hodhi poshtë vendimin,<ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|last1=Phillips |first1=Tom |last2=Holmes |first2=Oliver |last3=Bowcott |first3=Owen |date=July 12, 2016 |title=Beijing rejects tribunal's ruling in South China Sea case |language=en |work=The Guardian |url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jul/12/philippines-wins-south-china-sea-case-against-china |access-date=November 11, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160712120247/https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jul/12/philippines-wins-south-china-sea-case-against-china |archive-date=July 12, 2016}}</ref> dhe miratoi ligje të reja detare të Filipineve,<ref>{{Cite news |last1=Cao |first1=Ella |date=November 10, 2024 |title=China opposes new Philippine maritime law, vows to protect South China Sea 'sovereignty' |newspaper=Reuters |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/china-opposes-new-philippine-maritime-law-vows-protect-south-china-sea-2024-11-10/ |access-date=November 11, 2024 |language=en}}</ref> duke e kthyer cekëtinën në simbol të spikatur të mosmarrëveshjes më të gjerë.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|last=Carpio |first=Antonio T. |author-link=Antonio Carpio |date=July 23, 2020 |title=Scarborough Shoal – a redline |newspaper=Philippine Daily Inquirer |url=https://opinion.inquirer.net/132035/scarborough-shoal-a-redline |access-date=August 7, 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200724111626/https://opinion.inquirer.net/132035/scarborough-shoal-a-redline |archive-date=July 24, 2020 |language=en}}</ref>
=== Ushtria ===
{{Kryesor|Forcat e Armatosura të Filipineve}}
[[File:Philippine Navy frigate BRP Miguel Malvar (FFG-6) Arrives to Pearl Harbor for RIMPAC 2026 -01.jpg|thumb|[[BRP Miguel Malvar (FFG-6)|BRP Miguel Malvar (FFG6)]] mbërrin në Bazën e Përbashkët Pearl Harbor-Hickam për të marrë pjesë në stërvitjen Rim of the Pacific (RIMPAC) 2026.]]
Forcat e Armatosura të Filipineve (AFP), të përbëra nga vullnetarë, kanë tri degë: {{ill|Forca Ajrore Filipine|en|Philippine Air Force}}, {{ill|Ushtria Filipine|en|Philippine Army}} dhe {{ill|Marina Filipine|en|Philippine Navy}}.<ref>{{Cite web|title=AFP Organization|url=http://www.afp.mil.ph/org3.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050307023417/http://www.afp.mil.ph/org3.html|archive-date=2005-03-07|access-date=2020-07-06|publisher=Forcat e Armatosura të Filipineve|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|editor-last1=Casey-Maslen|editor-first1=Stuart|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=VjvKBQAAQBAJ|title=The War Report: Armed Conflict in 2013|date=2014|publisher=Oxford University Press|location=Oxford, England|isbn=978-0-19-103764-1|page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=VjvKBQAAQBAJ&pg=PA180 180]|language=en}}</ref> Siguria civile është përgjegjësi e [[Policia Kombëtare Filipine|Policisë Kombëtare të Filipineve]], nën varësinë e {{ill|Departamenti i Punëve të Brendshme dhe i Qeverisjes Vendore|en|Department of the Interior and Local Government}}.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Department of the Interior and Local Government Act of 1990|url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/1990/12/13/republic-act-no-6975/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170829090530/https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/1990/12/13/republic-act-no-6975/|archive-date=2017-08-29|access-date=2023-02-03|publisher=Official Gazette of the Republic of the Philippines|location=Metro Manila, Philippines|date=1990-12-13|language=en}}</ref> Në vitin 2022, AFP-ja kishte gjithsej rreth 280.000 pjesëtarë, prej të cilëve 130.000 ishin personel ushtarak aktiv, 100.000 rezervistë dhe 50.000 pjesëtarë të {{ill|Njësia Gjeografike e Forcave të Armatosura Qytetare|en|Citizen Armed Force Geographical Unit}}.<ref>{{Cite news|last=Baclig|first=Cristina Eloisa|date=2022-01-20|title=PH 51st on list of world's most powerful militaries|language=en|newspaper=Philippine Daily Inquirer|url=https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1542851/ph-51st-on-list-of-worlds-most-powerful-militaries-2|access-date=2023-02-20|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220120053550/https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1542851/ph-51st-on-list-of-worlds-most-powerful-militaries-2|archive-date=2022-01-20}}</ref>

Në vitin 2023, për ushtrinë filipinase u shpenzuan 477 milionë dollarë amerikanë, ose 1,4 për qind e PBB-së.<ref>{{Cite news|last1=Guild|first1=James|title=The Philippines' $35 Billion Military Modernization Plan, Explained|url=https://thediplomat.com/2024/05/the-philippines-35-billion-military-modernization-plan-explained/|access-date=2024-10-21|work=The Diplomat|date=2024-05-17|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240517144924/https://thediplomat.com/2024/05/the-philippines-35-billion-military-modernization-plan-explained/|archive-date=2024-05-17|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|title=How does the Philippines compare in the region in terms of military expenditure as share of GDP?|url=https://www.bworldonline.com/infographics/2024/08/20/614989/how-does-the-philippines-compare-in-the-region-in-terms-of-military-expenditure-as-share-of-gdp/|access-date=2024-10-21|work=BusinessWorld|date=2024-08-20|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240820024146/https://www.bworldonline.com/infographics/2024/08/20/614989/how-does-the-philippines-compare-in-the-region-in-terms-of-military-expenditure-as-share-of-gdp/|archive-date=2024-08-20|language=en}}</ref> Pjesa më e madhe e shpenzimeve të mbrojtjes së vendit shkon për Ushtrinë Filipine, e cila udhëheq operacionet kundër kërcënimeve të brendshme, si kryengritjet komuniste dhe ato separatiste myslimane të {{ill|Konflikteve të armatosura komuniste në Filipine|en|Communist armed conflicts in the Philippines}} dhe {{ill|Konfliktit Moro|en|Moro conflict}}. Përqendrimi i saj te siguria e brendshme kontribuoi në rënien e aftësive detare filipinase, e cila nisi gjatë viteve 1970.<ref>{{Cite book|editor-last1=Till|editor-first1=Geoffrey|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=_bNtAAAAQBAJ|title=Naval Modernisation in South-East Asia: Nature, Causes and Consequences|series=Cass Series: Naval Policy and History|editor-last2=Chan|editor-first2=Jane|date=2013-08-15|publisher={{ill|Routledge|en|Routledge}}|location=Oxfordshire, England|isbn=978-1-135-95394-2|page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=_bNtAAAAQBAJ&pg=PA150 150]|author-link1=Geoffrey Till|language=en}}</ref> Një program modernizimi ushtarak nisi në vitin 1995.<ref>{{Cite book|editor-last1=Wu|editor-first1=Shicun|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=qM5ZAgAAQBAJ|title=Securing the Safety of Navigation in East Asia: Legal and Political Dimensions|series=Chandos Asian Studies Series|editor-last2=Zou|editor-first2=Keyuan|date=2013-11-21|publisher=Elsevier|location=Oxford, England|isbn=978-1-78242-160-3|page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=qM5ZAgAAQBAJ&pg=PA35 35]|language=en}}</ref>
dhe u zgjerua në vitin 2012 për të ndërtuar një sistem më të aftë të mbrojtjes.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2012-12-11 |title=Aquino signs revised AFP Modernization Act |work=The Philippine Star |url=https://www.philstar.com/pilipino-star-ngayon/headlines/2012/12/11/884844/aquino-signs-revised-afp-modernization-act |access-date=2023-03-01 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220421114944/https://www.philstar.com/pilipino-star-ngayon/headlines/2012/12/11/884844/aquino-signs-revised-afp-modernization-act |archive-date=2022-04-21 |language=en}}</ref>

Filipinet kanë luftuar prej kohësh kundër {{ill|kryengritjeve vendore|en|Civil conflict in the Philippines}}, {{ill|separatizmit|en|Separatism in the Philippines}} dhe {{ill|terrorizmit|en|Terrorism in the Philippines}}.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Arnold |first=Guy |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=L3TqDAAAQBAJ |title=Wars in the Third World Since 1945 |series=History and Politics in the 20th Century: Conflict: Bloomsbury Academic Collections |date=2016 |publisher=Bloomsbury Publishing |location=London |isbn=978-1-4742-9101-9 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=L3TqDAAAQBAJ&pg=PA497 497] |language=en}}</ref><ref name="Croissant-2017">{{Cite book |last1=Croissant |first1=Aurel |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=77xEDwAAQBAJ |title=Comparative Politics of Southeast Asia: An Introduction to Governments and Political Regimes |last2=Lorenz |first2=Philip |date=2017 |publisher={{ill|Springer Science+Business Media|en|Springer Science+Business Media}} |location=Cham, Switzerland |isbn=978-3-319-68182-5 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=77xEDwAAQBAJ&pg=PA243 243] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=GTD Search Results; Philippines |url=https://www.start.umd.edu/gtd/search/Results.aspx?page=1&casualties_type=&casualties_max=&country=160&charttype=line&chart=overtime&ob=GTDID&od=desc&expanded=yes |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230315083451/https://www.start.umd.edu/gtd/search/Results.aspx?page=1&casualties_type=&casualties_max=&country=160&charttype=line&chart=overtime&ob=GTDID&od=desc&expanded=yes {{ill|Bangsamoros|en|Bangsamoro}}, {{ill|Fronti Nacional Çlirimtar Moro|en|Moro National Liberation Front}} dhe {{ill|Fronti Çlirimtar Islamik Moro|en|Moro Islamic Liberation Front}}, nënshkruan marrëveshje përfundimtare paqeje me qeverinë përkatësisht në vitin [[1996]] dhe në vitin [[2014]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=MMP: Moro National Liberation Front |url=https://cisac.fsi.stanford.edu/mappingmilitants/profiles/moro-national-liberation-front#text_block_20212 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221101073611/https://cisac.fsi.stanford.edu/mappingmilitants/profiles/moro-national-liberation-front |archive-date=2022-11-01 |access-date=2023-02-14 |last2=Burgonio |first2=TJ |date=2014-03-28 |title=Philippines, MILF sign peace agreement |language=en |newspaper=Philippine Daily Inquirer |url=https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/589706/bangsamoro-rising |access-date=2023-02-14 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140328040452/https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/589706/bangsamoro-rising |archive-date=2014-03-28}}</ref> Grupe të tjera më militante, si {{ill|Abu Sayyaf|en|Abu Sayyaf}} dhe {{ill|Luftëtarët e Lirisë Islamike të Bangsamoros|en|Bangsamoro Islamic Freedom Fighters}},<ref name="CTCSentinel-BIFF">{{Cite journal |last1=Chalk |first1=Peter |title=The Bangsamoro Islamic Freedom Fighters: The Newest Obstacles to Peace in the Southern Philippines? |journal=CTC Sentinel |date=November 2013 |volume=6 |issue=11–12 |pages=15–17 |url=https://apps.dtic.mil/sti/pdfs/ADA590315.pdf |access-date=2023-06-18 |publisher=Combating Terrorism Center at West Point |oclc=872740536 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230619003423/https://apps.dtic.mil/sti/pdfs/ADA590315.pdf |archive-date=2023-06-19 |via=Defense Technical Information Center |language=en}}</ref> kanë rrëmbyer të huaj për shpërblim, veçanërisht në [[Arkipelagu Sulu|Arkipelagun Sulu]]<ref>{{Cite book |author=International Institute for Strategic Studies |title=Armed Conflict Survey 2021 |date=2021-09-20 |publisher=Routledge |location=Abingdon, Oxon, England |isbn=978-1-000-54558-6 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=xONDEAAAQBAJ&pg=PT539 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=BpGXBwAAQBAJ |language=en}}</ref> dhe [[Maguindanao]]s,<ref name="CTCSentinel-BIFF" /> por prania e tyre është zvogëluar.<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Schiavo-Campo |url=http://siteresources.worldbank.org/INTCPR/214578-1111996036679/20482477/WP24_Web.pdf |series=Working Papers Series |publisher=The World Bank |location=Washington, D.C. |oclc=992235323 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Nepomuceno |first=Priam |date=2020-10-10 |title=PH Army keen to end terror threat with arrest of 3 terrorists |work=Philippine News Agency |language=en}}</ref>

{{ill|Partia Komuniste e Filipineve|en|Communist Party of the Philippines}} (CPP) dhe krahu i saj ushtarak, {{ill|Ushtria e Re Popullore|en|New People's Army}} (NPA), kanë zhvilluar [[lufta guerile|luftë guerile]] kundër qeverisë që nga vitet 1970 dhe kanë kryer prita, bombardime e vrasje të zyrtarëve qeveritarë dhe forcave të sigurisë;<ref name="CIAWorldFactBook-2022-2023">{{Cite book |last=Central Intelligence Agency |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=BOFIEAAAQBAJ&pg=PT4659 |title=CIA World Factbook 2022–2023 |date=2022-06-21 |publisher=Skyhorse Publishing |location=New York |isbn=978-1-5107-7119-2 |language=en}}</ref> ndonëse fuqia e tyre ushtarake dhe politike është zvogëluar pas rikthimit të demokracisë në vitin 1986,<ref name="Croissant-2017" /><ref>{{Cite book |last=White |first=Jonathan R. |edition=Seventh |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=LWF-twYVE7sC |title=Terrorism and Homeland Security |date=2011 |publisher=Wadsworth Cengage Learning |location=Belmont, Calif. |isbn=978-0-495-91336-8 |page=363 |language=en}}</ref> CPP-NPA, përmes {{ill|Frontit Nacional Demokratik të Filipineve|en|National Democratic Front of the Philippines}}, vazhdon të mbledhë mbështetje publike në zonat urbane duke krijuar fronte komuniste, duke depërtuar në organizata sektoriale dhe duke nxitur pakënaqësinë publike e rritjen e militantizmit kundër qeverisë.<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Gibert |first1=Stephen P. |title=Security In Northeast Asia: Approaching The Pacific Century |date=2019 |publisher={{ill|Routledge|en|Routledge}} |location=New York |isbn=978-1-000-31112-9 |at=The Nature of the Internal Crisis |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=OMzKDwAAQBAJ |access-date=2024-08-11 |language=en}}</ref> Filipinet u renditën në vendin e 104-të ndër 163 vende në [[Indeksi Global i Paqes|Indeksin Global të Paqes]] të vitit 2024.<ref>{{Cite report |title=Global Peace Index 2024: Measuring Peace in a Complex World |date=June 2024 |publisher=Institute for Economics & Peace |location=Sydney, Australia |isbn=978-0-646-87920-8 |page=9 |url=https://www.economicsandpeace.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/GPI-2024-web.pdf |language=en}}</ref>
=== Ndarjet administrative ===
{{Hatnote|Artikulli kryesor: {{ill|Ndarjet administrative të Filipineve|en|Administrative divisions of the Philippines}}}}

[[File:Ph regions and provinces.svg|thumb|upright=1.2|alt=Hartë politike e Filipineve me kodim sipas ngjyrave|Rajonet dhe provincat e Filipineve]]

Filipinet ndahen në 18 [[Rajonet e Filipineve|rajone]], 82 {{ill|Provincat e Filipineve|en|Provinces of the Philippines}}, 149 {{ill|Qytetet e Filipineve|en|Cities of the Philippines}}, 1.493 {{ill|Bashkitë e Filipineve|en|Municipalities of the Philippines}} dhe 42.011 barangay.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Provincial Summary: Number of Provinces, Cities, Municipalities and Barangays, by Region as of September 30, 2016 |url=http://nap.psa.gov.ph/activestats/psgc/SUMWEBPROV-SEPT2016-CODED-HUC-FINAL.pdf |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170110151057/http://nap.psa.gov.ph/activestats/psgc/SUMWEBPROV-SEPT2016-CODED-HUC-FINAL.pdf |archive-date=2017-01-10 |access-date=2017-01-05 |publisher=Philippine Statistics Authority |language=en}}</ref> Rajonet, përveç {{ill|Bangsamoros|en|Bangsamoro}}, janë ndarë për lehtësi administrative.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Tusalem |first=Rollin F |date=2019-04-09 |title=Imperial Manila: How institutions and political geography disadvantage Philippine provinces |journal=Asian Journal of Comparative Politics |volume=5 |issue=3 |pages=8–9, 11–12 |doi=10.1177/2057891119841441 |publisher=SAGE Publications Ltd |s2cid=159099808 |language=en}}</ref> {{ill|Calabarzon|en|Calabarzon}} ishte rajoni me popullsinë më të madhe {{As of|2020|lc=y}}. {{ill|Metro Manila|en|Metro Manila}} (NCR) kishte dendësinë më të madhe të popullsisë.<ref name="PSA-2020-Census-Highlights">{{Cite report |last=Mapa |first=Dennis S. |author-link1=Dennis Mapa |date=2021-07-23 |title=Highlights of the Population Density of the Philippines 2020 Census of Population and Housing (2020 CPH) |url=https://psa.gov.ph/content/highlights-population-density-philippines-2020-census-population-and-housing-2020-cph |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210726073127/https://psa.gov.ph/content/highlights-population-density-philippines-2020-census-population-and-housing-2020-cph |archive-date=2021-07-26 Filipinet janë një [[Shteti unitar|shtet unitar]], sistem i vendosur që nga [[Kapitaneria e Përgjithshme e Filipineve|sundimi kolonial spanjoll]], me përjashtim të Rajonit Autonom Bangsamoro në Mindanaon Myslimane.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=de Villiers |first=Bertus |date=2015 |title=Special regional autonomy in a unitary system – preliminary observations on the case of the Bangsomoro homeland in the Philippines |journal=Verfassung und Recht in Übersee / Law and Politics in Africa, Asia and Latin America |publisher=Nomos-Verlagsgesellschaft |volume=48 |issue=2 |pages=205–226 |doi=10.5771/0506-7286-2015-2-205 |issn=0506-7286 |jstor=26160114 |language=en}}</ref><ref name="Unitary">{{Cite web |date=November 2019 |title=Federal Systems, Intergovernmental Relations and Federated Regions |url=https://www.idea.int/sites/default/files/publications/federal-systems-intergovernmental-relations-and-federated-regions.pdf |access-date=2026-05-26 |website=idea.int |publisher=International IDEA |language=en}}</ref> Janë ndërmarrë hapa drejt decentralizimit.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Buendia |first=Rizal G. |date=April 1989 |title=The Prospects of Federalism in the Philippines: A Challenge to Political Decentralization of the Unitary State |url=https://www.pssc.org.ph/wp-content/pssc-archives/Philippine%20Journal%20of%20Public%20Administration/1989/Num%202/06_The%20Prospects%20of%20Federalism%20in%20the%20Philippines.pdf |journal=Philippine Journal of Public Administration |publisher=University of the Philippines |volume=33 |issue=2 |pages=121–122 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210917050906/https://www.pssc.org.ph/wp-content/pssc-archives/Philippine%20Journal%20of%20Public%20Administration/1989/Num%202/06_The%20Prospects%20of%20Federalism%20in%20the%20Philippines.pdf |archive-date=2021-09-17 |access-date=2023-04-02 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Tigno |first=Jorge V. |date=2017 |title=Beg Your Pardon? The Philippines is Already Federalized in All but Name |url=https://cids.up.edu.ph/wp-content/uploads/ppj-16-17-tigno-2017.pdf |journal=Philippine Journal of Public Policy: Interdisciplinary Development Perspectives |volume=16 and 17 |pages=1–14 |publisher=University of the Philippines Center for Integrative and Development Studies |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210116032627/https://cids.up.edu.ph/wp-content/uploads/ppj-16-17-tigno-2017.pdf |archive-date=2021-01-16 |access-date=2020-08-08 |language=en}}</ref> Një ligj i vitit 1991 u transferoi disa kompetenca qeverive vendore.<ref>{{Cite report |last1=Atienza |first1=Maria Ela L. |url=https://www.idea.int/sites/default/files/publications/constitutional-performance-assessment-1987-philippine-constitution.pdf |title=Constitutional Performance Assessment of the 1987 Philippine Constitution: Summary of Findings |last2=Arugay |first2=Aries A. |last3=Dee |first3=Francis Joseph A. |last4=Encinas-Franco |first4=Jean |last5=Go |first5=Jan Robert R. |last6=Panao |first6=Rogelio Alicor L. |last7=Jimenez |first7=Alinia Jesam D. |date=2020 |publisher=International Institute for Democracy and Electoral Assistance; University of the Philippines Center for Integrative and Development Studies |location=Stockholm, Sweden and Quezon City, Philippines |isbn=978-91-7671-299-3 |doi=10.31752/idea.2020.2 |editor-last=Atienza |editor-first=Maria Ela L. |page=37 |access-date=2020-12-01 |editor-last2=Cats-Baril |editor-first2=Amanda |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210328053237/https://www.idea.int/sites/default/files/publications/constitutional-performance-assessment-1987-philippine-constitution.pdf |archive-date=2021-03-28 |language=en}}</ref>
== Ekonomia ==
{{Hatnote|Artikulli kryesor: {{ill|Ekonomia e Filipineve|en|Economy of the Philippines}}}}

Sipas [[Fondi Monetar Ndërkombëtar|Fondit Monetar Ndërkombëtar]] (FMN), në raportin e vitit 2026, Filipinet kanë ekonominë e 35-të më të madhe në botë, me një [[Prodhimi i Brendshëm Bruto|prodhim të brendshëm bruto]] (PBB) nominal prej 501,692 miliardë dollarësh.<ref name="IMFWEO.PH" /> Si {{ill|vend i sapoindustrializuar|en|Newly industrialized country}},<ref name="FederalRegister-Vol78" /><ref>{{Cite book |editor-last1=Yu Chang |editor-first1=Albert Vincent Y. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=N9Ii3nTZ37AC |title=A Legal Guide to Doing Business in the Asia-Pacific |editor-last2=Thorson |editor-first2=Andrew |date=2010 |publisher=American Bar Association |location=Chicago, Ill. |isbn=978-1-60442-843-8 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=N9Ii3nTZ37AC&pg=PA288 288] |language=en}}</ref> ekonomia filipinase po kalon nga një bazë bujqësore drejt një strukture që i kushton më shumë rëndësi shërbimeve dhe prodhimit industrial.<ref name="FederalRegister-Vol78">{{Cite journal |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=EIG4iINKSOgC |journal=Federal Register |title=Commercial Setting: The Philippines |date=March 15, 2013 |publisher=Office of the Federal Register, National Archives and Records Service, General Services Administration |volume=78 |issue=51 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=EIG4iINKSOgC&pg=PA16468 16468] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite press release |date=2023-01-26 |title=GDP Expands by 7.2 Percent in the Fourth Quarter of 2022, and by 7.6 Percent in Full-year 2022 |url=https://psa.gov.ph/national-accounts |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230130010406/https://psa.gov.ph/national-accounts |archive-date=2023-01-30 |access-date=2023-03-13 |publisher=Philippine Statistics Authority |language=en}}</ref> Fuqia punëtore e vendit përbëhet nga rreth 52,09 milionë njerëz,<ref name="ph-employmentrate" /> ndërsa shkalla e papunësisë ishte 5,1 për qind {{As of|2026|2|lc=y}}.<ref name="ph-employmentrate">{{Cite news |date=2026-04-08 |title=Unemployment Rate Declined to 5.1 Percent as Labor Market Conditions Improved in February 2026 |url=https://psa.gov.ph/content/unemployment-rate-declined-51-percent-labor-market-conditions-improved-february-2026 |access-date=2026-04-10 |publisher=psa.gov.ph |language=en}}</ref> Rezervat bruto ndërkombëtare arritën në {{currency|106.64&nbsp;billion|USD|linked=no|passthrough=yes}} {{As of|2026|March|lc=y}}.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Gross International Reserves |url=https://www.bsp.gov.ph/Statistics/sdds/table12_data.aspx |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240215120950/https://www.bsp.gov.ph/Statistics/sdds/table12_data.aspx |archive-date=2024-02-15 |publisher=Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> Raporti i borxhit ndaj PBB-së ra në 60,2 për qind në fund të vitit 2023, nga niveli më i lartë në 17 vjet, prej 63,7 për qind, në fund të tremujorit të tretë të atij viti; kjo tregoi qëndrueshmëri gjatë pandemisë së {{ill|COVID-19 në Filipine|en|COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines}}.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Gonzalez |first=Anna Leah |title=PH debt-to-GDP improves in 2023 |work=Philippine News Agency |url=https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1217973 [[Valuta|pesoja filipinase]] (₱<ref>{{Cite book |section=Executive Order No. 66 |title=Executive Orders and Proclamations Issued by the Governor-General [1903] |date=1903-08-03 |url=https://quod.lib.umich.edu/p/philamer/ACD6603.1903.001/91 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200817095343/https://quod.lib.umich.edu/p/philamer/ACD6603.1903.001/91 |archive-date=2020-08-17 |access-date=2020-08-17 |page=89 |publisher=Bureau of Public Prints |language=en}}</ref> ose PHP<ref>{{Cite web |date=2018-08-29 |title=List one: Currency, fund and precious metal codes |url=https://www.currency-iso.org/dam/downloads/lists/list_one.xls |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200511031332/https://www.currency-iso.org/dam/downloads/lists/list_one.xls |archive-date=2020-05-11 |access-date=2020-08-17 |publisher=[[Organizata Ndërkombëtare për Standardizim|Agjencia e Mirëmbajtjes së ISO 4217]] |format=XLS |language=en}}</ref>).<ref>{{Cite report |last=International Monetary Fund. Monetary and Capital Markets Department |url=https://www.elibrary.imf.org/downloadpdf/book/9781451942804/9781451942804.pdf |title=Annual Report on Exchange Arrangements and Exchange Restrictions 1999 |date=1999-09-17 |publisher=International Monetary Fund |location=Washington, D.C. |isbn=978-1-4519-4280-4 |page=683 |access-date=2023-04-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230409193323/https://www.elibrary.imf.org/downloadpdf/book/9781451942804/9781451942804.pdf |archive-date=2023-04-09 |language=en}}</ref>

Filipinet janë importuese neto,<ref name="ILOOrg-2019" />{{Rp|pages=55–56,61–65,77,83,111}}<ref>{{Cite news |last1=Gadon |first1=Bernadette Therese M. |title=2021 trade deficit widest in 3 years |url=https://www.bworldonline.com/top-stories/2022/04/22/443881/2021-trade-deficit-widest-in-3-years/ |access-date=2023-04-22 |work=BusinessWorld |date=2022-04-21 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220421200131/https://www.bworldonline.com/top-stories/2022/04/22/443881/2021-trade-deficit-widest-in-3-years/ |archive-date=2022-04-21 |language=en}}</ref>
dhe një [[Net international investment position|vend debitor për pozicionin neto të investimeve ndërkombëtare]].<ref>{{cite news|year=2022|title=Philippines Net International Investment Position|publisher=CEIC|url=https://www.ceicdata.com/en/indicator/philippines/net-international-investment-position|access-date=2023-05-02|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230311060132/https://www.ceicdata.com/en/indicator/philippines/net-international-investment-position|archive-date=2023-03-11|language=en}}</ref> {{As of|2020}}, tregjet kryesore të eksportit të vendit ishin Kina, Shtetet e Bashkuara, Japonia, Hong Kongu dhe Singapori;<ref name="OECWorld-PH">{{cite web|title=Philippines (PHL) Exports, Imports, and Trade Partners|url=https://oec.world/en/profile/country/phl|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221205044653/https://oec.world/en/profile/country/phl|archive-date=2022-12-05|access-date=2023-02-26|publisher=Observatory of Economic Complexity|language=en}}</ref> eksportet kryesore përfshinin [[Qarku i integruar|qarqe të integruara]], makineri zyre dhe pjesë këmbimi, transformatorë elektrikë, tela të izoluar dhe [[Gjysmëpërçuesi|gjysmëpërçues]].<ref name="OECWorld-PH" /> Atë vit, tregjet kryesore nga të cilat importonte ishin Kina, Japonia, Koreja e Jugut, Shtetet e Bashkuara dhe Indonezia.<ref name="OECWorld-PH" /> Kulturat kryesore bujqësore për eksport përfshijnë arrat e kokosit, bananet dhe ananasit; vendi është prodhuesi më i madh në botë i abakës,<ref name="Boquet-2017" />{{Rp|pages={{Plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=90C4DgAAQBAJ&pg=PA226|name=226–242}}}} dhe në vitin 2022 ishte eksportuesi i dytë më i madh në botë i [[Nikeli|xehes së nikelit]],<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-01-30/philippines-may-tax-nickel-exports-to-follow-indonesia-s-success#xj4y7vzkg|url-access=subscription|title=Nickel Gets Fresh Supply Risk as Philippines Mulls Export Tax|last1=Serapio|first1=Manolo Jr.|last2=Calonzo|first2=Andreo|date=2023-01-30|work=Bloomberg|language=en|access-date=2023-05-02}}</ref> si edhe eksportuesi më i madh i metaleve të veshura me ar dhe importuesi më i madh i koprës në vitin 2020.<ref name="OECWorld-PH" />
[[File:Head Quarters of the International Rice Research Institute in Los Baños - panoramio.jpg|thumb|alt=Ndërtesë moderne zyrash me peizazh të rregulluar|Selia e [[International Rice Research Institute|Institutit Ndërkombëtar të Kërkimit të Orizit]] në [[Los Baños, Laguna|Los Baños]]]]
Me një normë mesatare vjetore rritjeje prej gjashtë deri në shtatë për qind që prej rreth vitit 2010, Filipinet janë bërë një nga ekonomitë me rritjen më të shpejtë në botë,<ref>{{cite news|last1=Biswas|first1=Rajiv|title=Philippines amongst world's fastest growing emerging markets|url=https://www.spglobal.com/marketintelligence/en/mi/research-analysis/philippines-amongst-worlds-fastest-growing-emerging-markets-Mar23.html|access-date=2023-04-02|work=IHS kryesisht falë mbështetjes gjithnjë e më të madhe te sektori i shërbimeve.<ref name="OECD-SMEPolicyIndex2018">{{cite book|title=SME Policy Index: ASEAN 2018: Boosting Competitiveness and Inclusive Growth|date=2018-09-21|chapter=The Philippines|pages=371–373|publisher=OECD Publishing; Economic Research Institute for ASEAN and East Asia|location=Paris, Francë; Xhakartë, Indonezi|isbn=978-92-64-30531-1|url=https://www.oecd-ilibrary.org/development/sme-policy-index-asean-2018_9789264305328-en|chapter-url=https://www.oecd-ilibrary.org/docserver/9789264305328-22-en.pdf|access-date=2023-05-12|language=en|doi=10.1787/9789264305328-22-en|doi-access=free}}</ref> Megjithatë, zhvillimi rajonal është i pabarabartë: Manila, veçanërisht, përfiton pjesën më të madhe të rritjes së re ekonomike.<ref>{{cite journal|type=Conference proceeding|date=2018|title=Critical Perspectives on Federalism for Regional Development (Proceedings of the Third Annual Public Policy Conference Studies|page=xvii|issn=2546-1761|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230208162326/https://pidswebs.pids.gov.ph/CDN/PUBLICATIONS/pidsbk2018-appc2017.pdf|archive-date=2023-02-08|access-date=2023-02-08|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last=Fajardo|first=Fernando|date=2014-03-05|title=Poverty and regional development imbalance|newspaper=Philippine Daily Inquirer|url=http://cebudailynews.inquirer.net/22630/poverty-and-regional-development-imbalance|access-date=2020-07-19|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150222102526/http://cebudailynews.inquirer.net/22630/poverty-and-regional-development-imbalance|archive-date=2015-02-22|language=en}}</ref> [[Remitenca|Remitencat]] nga filipinasit që jetojnë jashtë vendit, kryesisht [[Detari|detarët]]<ref>{{cite report|author=BIMCO/ICS|title=Seafarer Workforce Report 2021|url=https://www.ics-shipping.org/publication/seafarer-workforce-report-2021-edition/|publisher=International Chamber of Shipping|date=2021|access-date=2026-03-18|quote=The Philippines continues tackling COVID-19 crises in OECD countries|url=https://www.oecd.org/coronavirus/policy-responses/contribution-of-migrant-doctors-and-nurses-to-tackling-covid-19-crises-in-oecd-countries-2f7bca01/|publisher=Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development|date=2020-05-13|access-date=2026-03-18|quote=The Philippines is the leading country of origin for foreign-trained nurses, representing a significant portion of the nursing journal|last1=Seriño|first1=Moises Neil V.|title=Effects of International Remittances on the Philippine Economy: A Cointegration Analysis|journal=DLSU Business & Economics Review|date=2012|volume=21|issue=2|pages=47–48|url=https://www.dlsu.edu.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/EffectsofInternationalRemittancesonthePhilippineEconomy_ACointegrationAnalysis.pdf|access-date=2023-04-30|publisher=De La Salle University|doi=10.59588/2243-786X.1587|oclc=855102346|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230430132943/https://www.dlsu.edu.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/EffectsofInternationalRemittancesonthePhilippineEconomy_ACointegrationAnalysis.pdf|archive-date=2023-04-30|language=en}}</ref><ref name="OECD-SMEPolicyIndex2018" /> në vitin 2023 ato arritën një rekord prej {{currency|37.20&nbsp;billion|USD|linked=no|passthrough=yes}}, duke përbërë 8,5 për qind të PBB-së.<ref>{{cite news|last=Gonzalez|first=Anna Leah|title=OFW remittances hit all-time high in 2023|work=Philippine News Filipinet janë qendra kryesore në botë për [[Business process outsourcing in the Philippines|nënkontraktimin e proceseve të biznesit]] (BPO).<ref>{{cite news|date=2010-12-02|title=Phl overtakes India as world's BPO leader|work=The Philippine Star|url=https://www.philstar.com/business/2010/12/02/634901/phl-overtakes-india-worlds-bpo-leader|access-date=2020-09-01|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200901193030/https://www.philstar.com/business/2010/12/02/634901/phl-overtakes-india-worlds-bpo-leader|archive-date=2020-09-01|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|last=Stevens|first=Andrew J. R.|series=Routledge Advances in Sociology|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=CZ0sAwAAQBAJ|title=Call Centers and the Global Division of Labor: A Political Economy of Post-Industrial Employment and Union Organizing|date=2014|publisher={{ill|Routledge|en|Routledge}}|location=New York|isbn=978-1-135-11868-6|page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=CZ0sAwAAQBAJ&pg=PA1 1]|language=en}}</ref> Rreth 1,3 milionë filipinas punojnë në sektorin BPO, kryesisht në shërbimin ndaj klientit.<ref>{{cite book|editor-last1=Arenas|editor-first1=Guillermo|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=dFWYEAAAQBAJ|title=A New Dawn for Global Value Chain Participation in the Philippines|series=International Development in Focus|editor-last2=Coulibaly|editor-first2=Souleymane|date=2022|publisher=World Bank Publications|location=Uashington, D.C.|isbn=978-1-4648-1848-6|pages=[https://books.google.com/books?id=dFWYEAAAQBAJ&pg=PA28 28–29]|language=en}}</ref> Vendi është pionier në financat digjitale, si vendi i parë që vendosi të gjithë buxhetin e tij kombëtar në sistemin [[Blockchain|blockchain]].<ref>{{cite web|last=Venzon|first=Iñigo|title=Philippines becomes first country to put entire national budget on blockchain|url=https://www.yugatech.com/news/philippines-becomes-first-country-to-put-entire-national-budget-on-blockchain/|website=YugaTech|date=2026-01-15|access-date=2026-03-18|language=en}}</ref>

Ashtu si shumë qeveri të tjera, qeveria filipinase kryen veprimtari fitimprurëse përmes ndërmarrjeve shtetërore, të njohura si korporata në pronësi dhe nën kontroll të qeverisë (GOCC). Me përjashtim të [[Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas]], të gjitha GOCC-të, përfshirë korporatën e re dhe të debatueshme Maharlika Investment Corporation, janë nën mbikëqyrjen e Governance Commission for GOCCs.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://gcg.gov.ph/about|title=About|publisher=Governance Commission for GOCCs|access-date=2026-08-17|language=en}}</ref>
=== Shkenca dhe teknologjia ===
{{Hatnote|Artikulli kryesor: {{ill|Shkenca dhe teknologjia në Filipine|en|Science and technology in the Philippines}}}}
{{Hatnote|Shih më tej: {{ill|Programi hapësinor i Filipineve|en|Philippine space program}}}}

Filipinet kanë një nga sistemet më të mëdha të kërkimit bujqësor në Azi, pavarësisht shpenzimeve relativisht të ulëta për kërkimin dhe zhvillimin bujqësor.<ref>{{cite journal |last=Baconguis |first=Rowena T. |date=2022-02-14 |title=Agricultural Technology: Why Does the Level of Agricultural Production Remain Low Despite Increased Investments in Research and Extension? |url=https://think-asia.org/bitstream/handle/11540/14877/pidsdps2206.pdf?sequence=1 |journal=PIDS Discussion Paper Series |publisher=Philippine Institute for Development Studies |location=Quezon City, Philippines |oclc=1302730898 |page=6 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230224005936/https://think-asia.org/bitstream/handle/11540/14877/pidsdps2206.pdf?sequence=1 |archive-date=2023-02-24 |access-date=2023-02-24 |via=Think Asia |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite report |last1=Stads |first1=Gert-Jan |last2=Faylon |first2=Patricio S. |last3=Buendia |first3=Leah J. |title=Key trends in agricultural R&D investments in the Philippines |url=https://ebrary.ifpri.org/digital/collection/p15738coll2/id/32328 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230224034458/https://ebrary.ifpri.org/digital/collection/p15738coll2/id/32328 |date=March 2007 |archive-date=2023-02-24 |access-date=2023-02-24 |publisher=International Food Policy Research Institute, Philippine Council for Agriculture, Forestry and Natural Resources Research and Development |language=en}}</ref> Vendi ka zhvilluar varietete të reja kulturash bujqësore, përfshirë [[Prodhimi i orizit në Filipine|orizin]],<ref>{{cite book |type=Conference proceeding |editor-last1=Virmani |editor-first1=S. S. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=xA1jRdqJJzcC |title=Advances in Hybrid Rice Technology: Proceedings of the 3rd International Symposium on Hybrid Rice, 14–16 November 1996, Hyderabad, India |editor-last2=Siddiq |editor-first2=E. B. |editor-last2=Roa |editor-first2=V. N. |editor-last3=Maghuyop |editor-first3=M. A. {{ill|Agjencia Hapësinore e Filipineve|en|Philippine Space Agency}} administron programin hapësinor të vendit,<ref>{{cite book |editor-last1=Verspieren |editor-first1=Quentin |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=OQdZEAAAQBAJ |title=ASEAN Space Programs: History and Way Forward |editor-last2=Berthet |editor-first2=Maximilien |editor-last3=Coral |editor-first3=Giulio |editor-last4=Nakasuka |editor-first4=Shinichi |editor-last5=Shiroyama |editor-first5=Hideaki |date=2022-01-12 |publisher=Springer Nature |location=Singapore |isbn=978-981-16-7326-9 |pages=[https://books.google.com/books?id=OQdZEAAAQBAJ&pg=PA57 57–58] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite book |last=Kim |first=Doo Hwan |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=KUIoEAAAQBAJ |title=Global Issues Surrounding Outer Space Law and Policy |series=Advances in Public Policy and Administration (APPA) Book Series |date=2021 |publisher=IGI Global |location=Hershey, Pa. |isbn=978-1-7998-7409-6 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=KUIoEAAAQBAJ&pg=PA69 69] |language=en}}</ref>
dhe vendi bleu satelitin e tij të parë në vitin 1996.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|date=1996-07-25 |title=Mabuhay acquires Indon satellite; sets new orbit |page=9 |work=Manila Standard |url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?nid=1370&dat=19960725&id=9mUVAAAAIBAJ&pg=6158,3894648 |access-date=2020-07-06 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200728061150/https://news.google.com/newspapers?nid=1370&dat=19960725&id=9mUVAAAAIBAJ&pg=6158,3894648 |archive-date=2020-07-28 |via=[[Google News]] |language=en}}</ref> [[Diwata-1]], mikrosateliti i parë i vendit, u lëshua në vitin 2016 nga anija kozmike [[Cygnus (anije kozmike)|Cygnus]] e Shteteve të Bashkuara.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|last=Ronda |first=Rainier Allan |date=2016-03-24 |title=US aircraft with Philippines's first microsatellite launched into space |work=The Philippine Star |url=http://www.philstar.com/headlines/2016/03/24/1566175/us-aircraft-philippiness-first-microsatellite-launched-space |access-date=2016-03-24 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160327120259/http://www.philstar.com/headlines/2016/03/24/1566175/us-aircraft-philippiness-first-microsatellite-launched-space |archive-date=2016-03-27 |language=en}}</ref>

Filipinet ka një përqendrim të lartë të përdoruesve të [[Telefoni mobil|telefonisë celulare]],<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Pertierra |first1=Raul |title=We Reveal Ourselves to Ourselves: The New Communication Media in the Philippines |journal=Social Science Diliman |date=June 2013 |volume=9 |issue=1 |page=25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170225214150/https://journals.upd.edu.ph/index.php/socialsciencediliman/article/view/3920/3573 |archive-date=2017-02-25 |language=en}}</ref> si dhe një nivel të lartë të tregtisë përmes telefonisë celulare.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|last=Teves |first=Oliver |date=2007-09-29 |title=Cell phones double as electronic wallets in Philippines |work=USA Today === Turizmi ===
{{Hatnote|Artikulli kryesor: {{ill|Turizmi në Filipine|en|Tourism in the Philippines}}}}

[[File:Chocolate Hills and tourists.jpg|thumb|alt=Njerëz në një platformë vrojtimi me pamje nga kodrat|Turistë në [[Chocolate Hills]], kodra konike prej [[Karsti|karstit]] në [[Bohol]]]]
Filipinet janë një destinacion i njohur për pensionistët e huaj për shkak të klimës dhe kostos së ulët të jetesës.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|last=Frost |first=Charles |date=May 31, 2015 |title=Best kryesore turistike të vendit janë plazhet e shumta;<ref name="Woods-2006" />{{rp|page={{Plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=eajOEAAAQBAJ&pg=109|name=109}}}}<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Zafra |first1=Maria Angela G. |title=Developing the Philippine Blue Economy: Opportunities and Challenges in the Ocean Tourism Sector |date=December 2021 |journal=ADBI Working Paper Series |issue=1291 |language=en}}</ref> vendi është gjithashtu një destinacion kryesor për të apasionuarit pas zhytjes.<ref>{{cite book |editor-last1=Nordquist |editor-first1=Myron H. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=Gny9DwAAQBAJ |title=Cooperation and Engagement in the Asia-Pacific Region |editor-last2=Moore |editor-first2=John më i mirë në botë nga ''[[Travel + Leisure]]'' në vitin 2012;<ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|last=Malig |first=Jojo |date=July 9, 2012 |title=Boracay named 2012 world's best island |work=ABS-CBN News |language=en-gb |work=[[National Geographic]] |url=https://www.nationalgeographic.co.uk/travel/bc/2022/11/beyond-the-beaches-five-unusual-experiences-in-the-philippines |access-date=February 20, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221128091050/https://www.nationalgeographic.co.uk/travel/bc/2022/11/beyond-the-beaches-five-unusual-experiences-in-the-philippines |archive-date=November 28, 2022}}</ref>

Turizmi kontribuoi me 5,2 për qind në PBB-në e Filipineve në vitin 2021 (më pak se 12,7 për qind në vitin 2019, para pandemisë së COVID-19),<ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|last=Ochave |first=Revin Mikhael D. |date=June 21, 2022 |title=Philippine tourism industry seen to reach pre-pandemic levels by 2024 |work=BusinessWorld |url=https://www.bworldonline.com/top-stories/2022/06/22/456578/philippine-tourism-industry-seen-to-reach-pre-pandemic-levels-by-2024/ |access-date=November 11, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220621174641/https://www.bworldonline.com/top-stories/2022/06/22/456578/philippine-tourism-industry-seen-to-reach-pre-pandemic-levels-by-2024/ |archive-date=June 21, 2022 |language=en}}</ref> dhe siguroi 5,7&nbsp;milionë vende pune në vitin 2019.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|date=October 21, 2020 |title=Inbound int'l tourism may pick up starting late 2021 |work=BusinessWorld |url=https://www.bworldonline.com/editors-picks/2020/10/22/324125/inbound-intl-tourism-may-pick-up-starting-late-2021/ |access-date=November 11, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221111072858/https://www.bworldonline.com/editors-picks/2020/10/22/324125/inbound-intl-tourism-may-pick-up-starting-late-2021/ |archive-date=November 11, 2022 |language=en}}</ref> Filipinet tërhoqën 5,45&nbsp;milionë vizitorë ndërkombëtarë në vitin 2023, 30 për qind më pak se rekordi prej 8,26 milionësh i vitit 2019, para pandemisë; shumica e turistëve erdhën nga Koreja e Jugut (26,4 për qind), Shtetet e Bashkuara (16,5 për qind), Japonia (5,6 për qind), Australia (4,89 për qind) dhe Kina (4,84 për qind).<ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|last1=Arnaldo |first1=Ma. Stella F. |title=International tourists spent $8.69 billion in PHL in 2023–DOT |url=https://businessmirror.com.ph/2024/01/03/international-tourists-spent-8-69-billion-in-phl-in-2023-dot/ |access-date=January 3, 2024 |work=BusinessMirror |date=January 3, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240102185145/https://businessmirror.com.ph/2024/01/03/international-tourists-spent-8-69-billion-in-phl-in-2023-dot/ |archive-date=January 2, 2024 |language=en}}</ref>
== Infrastruktura ==
=== Transporti ===
{{Hatnote|Artikulli kryesor: {{ill|Transporti në Filipine|en|Transportation in the Philippines}}}}
[[File:Traditional and modern jeepneys in Diliman, Quezon City on March 16, 2023.jpg|thumb|alt=Dy autobusë të bardhë pranë njëri-tjetrit, njëri më i madh se tjetri|''Tradicionalë (majtas)'' dhe modernë {{ill|jeepney|en|Jeepney}} në {{ill|Quezon City|en|Quezon City}}. Automjetet e shërbimit publik më të vjetra se 15 vjet po nxirren gradualisht jashtë përdorimit në favor të automjeteve ekologjike që përmbushin standardin [[Standardet evropiane të emetimeve|Euro 4]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Malasique |first1=Arion Mari P. |last2=Rubio |first2=Windsor Redz C. |last3=Rosete |first3=Marie Antoinette L. |title=Analyzing the Implementation of the Public Utility Vehicle Modernization Program (PUVMP) to the Employment of PUV Drivers in the Philippines |journal=Journal of Industrial Engineering & Management Research |date=2022-02-04 |volume=3 |issue=1 |pages=45, 48 |url=https://jiemar.org/index.php/jiemar/article/view/250/190 |access-date=2023-04-30 |issn=2722-8878 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230430050528/https://jiemar.org/index.php/jiemar/article/download/250/190/ |archive-date=2023-04-30 |language=en}}</ref>]]

Transporti në Filipine bëhet me rrugë tokësore, ajrore, hekurudhore dhe ujore. Rrugët janë forma kryesore e transportit, duke bartur 98 për qind të njerëzve dhe 58 për qind të mallrave.<ref name="ADBOrg-PH-Transport">{{Cite report |url=https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/institutional-document/33700/files/philippines-transport-assessment.pdf |title=Philippines: Transport Sector Assessment, Strategy, and Road Map |date=2012 |publisher={{ill|Banka Aziatike e Zhvillimit|en|Asian Development Bank}} |location=Mandaluyong, Philippines |isbn=978-92-9092-855-3 |pages=1–2 |access-date=2020-08-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160803210126/https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/institutional-document/33700/files/philippines-transport-assessment.pdf |archive-date=2016-08-03 |language=en}}</ref> Në dhjetor 2018, vendi kishte {{Convert|210528|km|mi|sp=us}} rrugë.<ref>{{Cite report |date=2019-02-22 |title=Department of Public Works and Highways; Strategic Infrastructure Programs and Policies |url=https://iro.ph/article_doc/eaaa3b67_Philippine%20Economic%20Briefing%20(Osaka,Japan)%20-%20DPWH%20Presentation.pdf |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200827174411/https://iro.ph/article_doc/eaaa3b67_Philippine%20Economic%20Briefing%20%28Osaka,Japan%29%20-%20DPWH%20Presentation.pdf |archive-date=2020-08-27 |access-date=2020-09-02 |website=Investor Relations Office |publisher=Department of Public Works and Highways |page=2 |language=en}}</ref> Shtylla kurrizore e transportit tokësor në vend është {{ill|Autostrada panfilipinase|en|Pan-Philippine Highway}}, e cila lidh ishujt e Luzonit, Samar, Leyte dhe Mindanaos.<ref>{{Cite report |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=wvYCDAAAQBAJ |title=The Report: Philippines 2015 |date=2015 |publisher=Oxford Business Group |location=London |isbn=978-1-910068-26-7 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=wvYCDAAAQBAJ&pg=PA152E 152] |language=en}}</ref> Transporti ndërmjet ishujve bëhet përmes {{ill|Autostradës detare të Republikës së Fortë|en|Strong Republic Nautical Highway}}, një rrjet i integruar rrugësh dhe linjash tragetesh me gjatësi {{Convert|919|km|mi|adj=on|sp=us}}, që lidh 17 qytete.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Odchimar |first1=Anita II |last2=Hanaoka |first2=Shinya |title=Intermodal Road-RoRo Transport in the Philippines, its Development and Position in the Domestic Shipping |journal=Journal of the Eastern Asia Society for Transportation Studies |date=2015 |volume=11 |pages=741–746 |doi=10.11175/easts.11.739 |url=https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/easts/11/0/11_739/_pdf/-char/ja |access-date=2023-05-10 |publisher=Eastern Asia Society for Transportation Studies |issn=1881-1124 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230510102758/https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/easts/11/0/11_739/_pdf/-char/ja |archive-date=2023-05-10 |via={{ill|J-STAGE|en|J-STAGE}} |doi-access=free |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite report |url=https://www.adb.org/publications/bridges-across-oceans-initial-impact-assessment-philippines-nautical-highway-system-and |title=Bridges across Oceans: Initial Impact Assessment of the Philippines Nautical Highway System and Lessons for Southeast Asia |date=April 2010 |publisher=Banka Aziatike e Zhvillimit |location=Metro Manila, Philippines |isbn=978-971-561-896-0 |pages=11–17 |access-date=2023-02-25
