Familja është në qendër të shoqërisë filipinase; norma të tilla si besnikëria, ruajtja e marrëdhënieve të ngushta dhe kujdesi për prindërit e moshuar janë të rrënjosura në këtë shoqëri.<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Smith |first1=Bradford |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=-932648SbP4C |title=Philanthropy in Communities of Color |last2=Shue |first2=Sylvia |last3=Vest |first3=Jennifer Lisa |last4=Villarreal |first4=Joseph |date=1999 |publisher=Indiana University Press |location=Bloomington, Ind. |isbn=978-0-253-11293-4 |pages=[https://books.google.com/books?id=-932648SbP4C&pg=PA89 89–90] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |editor-last1=Naylor |editor-first1=Larry L. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=HhUKBb807GsC |title=Cultural Diversity in the United States |date=1997 |publisher=Bergin & Garvey |location=Westport, Conn. |isbn=978-0-89789-479-1 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=HhUKBb807GsC&pg=PA179 179] |language=en}}</ref> Respekti për autoritetin dhe të moshuarit vlerësohet dhe shprehet përmes gjesteve si {{Lang|fil|mano}}, si dhe përdorimit të formave të nderimit {{Lang|fil|po}} dhe {{Lang|fil|opo}}, e të fjalëve {{Lang|fil|kuya}} (vëllai më i madh) ose {{Lang|fil|ate}} (motra më e madhe).<ref>{{Cite book |last=Bonifacio |first=Glenda Tibe |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=OXPQAQAAQBAJ |title=Pinay on the Prairies: Filipino Women and Transnational Identities |date=2013-11-15 |publisher=University of British Columbia Press |location=Vancouver, Canada |isbn=978-0-7748-2582-5 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=OXPQAQAAQBAJ&pg=PA192 192] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite encyclopedia |editor-last1=Nadal |editor-first1=Kevin Leo Yabut |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=cGN7EAAAQBAJ&pg=PT660 |encyclopedia=The SAGE Encyclopedia of Filipina/x/o American Studies |title=Family Structure |editor-last2=Tintiangco-Cubales |editor-first2=Allyson |editor-last3=David |editor-first3=E. J. R. |date=2022-11-03 |publisher=SAGE Publications |location=Thousand Oaks, Calif. |isbn=978-1-0718-2901-1 |at=Hierarchy |language=en |editor-link1=Kevin Nadal}}</ref> Vlera të tjera filipinase janë optimizmi për të ardhmen, pesimizmi për të tashmen, kujdesi për të tjerët, miqësia dhe dashamirësia, [[Mikpritja|mikpritja]], përkushtimi fetar, respekti për veten dhe të tjerët (veçanërisht [[Gratë në Filipine|gratë]]) dhe integriteti.<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Talisayon |first1=Serafin D. |editor-last1=Dy |editor-first1=Manuel B. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=hRoYc2hPg2sC |title=Values in Philippine Culture and Education |series=Cultural Heritage and Contemporary Change Series III. Asia; Philippine Philosophical Studies |volume=7 |publisher=Office of Research and Publications, Council for Research in Values and Philosophy |location=Washington, D.C. |year=1994 |isbn=978-1-56518-040-6 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=hRoYc2hPg2sC&pg=PA155 155] |chapter=Chapter 13: Teaching Values in the Natural and Physical Sciences in the Philippines |chapter-url=https://www.crvp.org/publications/Series-III/III-7.pdf |access-date=2020-09-03 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220804051616/https://www.crvp.org/publications/Series-III/III-7.pdf |archive-date=2022-08-04 |language=en}}</ref>
=== Arti dhe arkitektura ===
{{Hatnote|Artikulli kryesor: {{ill|Artet në Filipine|en|Arts in the Philippines}} dhe {{ill|Arkitektura e Filipineve|en|Architecture of the Philippines}}}}

Arti filipinas ndërthur artin popullor autokton, traditat e Azisë Lindore dhe traditat klasike.<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Panizo |first1=Alfredo |last2=Rustia |first2=Erlinda F. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=Y86zdJE87TsC |title=Introduction to Art Appreciation and Aesthetics: An Approach to the Humanities |publisher=REX Book Store, Inc. |location=Manila, Philippines |isbn=978-971-23-1932-7 |date=1969 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=Y86zdJE87TsC&pg=PA156 156] |language=en}}</ref><ref name="McFerson-2002">{{Cite book |editor-last1=McFerson |editor-first1=Hazel M. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=7FPLWmaGQpEC |title=Mixed Blessing: The Impact of the American Colonial Experience on Politics and Society in the Philippines |date=2002 |publisher=Greenwood Press |location=Westport, Conn. |isbn=978-0-313-30791-1 |pages=[https://books.google.com/books?id=7FPLWmaGQpEC&pg=PA22 22–23] |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":3">{{Cite web |last1=Hernandez |first1=Eloisa May P. |title=The Spanish Colonial Tradition in Philippine Visual Arts |url=http://ncca.gov.ph/subcommissions/subcommission-on-the-arts-sca/visual-arts/the-spanish-colonial-tradition-in-philippine-visual-arts/ |publisher=National Commission for Culture and the Arts |access-date=2023-04-29 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160421082733/http://ncca.gov.ph/subcommissions/subcommission-on-the-arts-sca/visual-arts/the-spanish-colonial-tradition-in-philippine-visual-arts/ |archive-date=2016-04-21 |date=2015-04-15 |at=A. Painting |language=en}}</ref> Gjatë periudhës koloniale spanjolle, arti u përdor për të përhapur katolicizmin, kryesisht përmes pikturave dhe skulpturave. Skulptori i parë i dokumentuar në Filipine është Juan de los Santos (1590–1660), i njohur për punimin e retablos.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=Hernandez |first=Eloisa May P. |title=The Spanish Colonial Tradition in Philippine Visual Arts |url=https://ncca.gov.ph/about-ncca-3/subcommissions/subcommission-on-the-arts-sca/visual-arts/the-spanish-colonial-tradition-in-philippine-visual-arts/ |website=National Commission for Culture and the Arts |access-date=2025-01-17 |archive-date=2021-04-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210418072402/https://ncca.gov.ph/about-ncca-3/subcommissions/subcommission-on-the-arts-sca/visual-arts/the-spanish-colonial-tradition-in-philippine-visual-arts/ |url-status=dead |language=en}}</ref> Në vitin 1821, {{ill|Damian Domingo|en|Damián Domingo}}, babai i pikturës filipinase, hapi në Binondo shkollën e artit [[Academia de Dibujo y Pintura|''Academia de Dibujo'']].<ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite book |last=Santiago |first=Luciano P.R. |title=DAMIAN DOMINGO AND THE FIRST PHILIPPINE ART ACADEMY (1821–1834) |publisher=University of San Carlos Publications |year=1991 |language=en}}</ref> Artistë të tjerë gjatë sundimit kolonial spanjoll përfshinin piktorë si Josef Luciano Dans, {{ill|Jose Honorato Lozano|en|José Honorato Lozano}}, Mariano Asuncion<ref>{{Cite book |last=Javellana |first=Rene B. |title=The Philippine Colonial Tradition of Sacred Art |publisher=National Museum of the Philippines and Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas |year=2020 |isbn=978-971-567-035-7 |language=en}}</ref> dhe skulptorë si {{ill|Isabelo Tampinco|en|Isabelo Tampinco}} dhe Crispulo Hocson.<ref name=":1" /> Ndër artistët, veprat e të cilëve tërhoqën vëmendjen te Filipinet, ishin {{ill|Juan Luna|en|Juan Luna}} dhe {{ill|Félix Resurrección Hidalgo|en|Félix Resurrección Hidalgo}}.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Ocampo |first=Ambeth |author-link=Ambeth Ocampo |title=Jose Rizal in Filipino Literature and History |url=https://archium.ateneo.edu/cgi/viewcontent.cgi?article=1042&context=history-faculty-pubs |publisher=Ateneo de Manila University |access-date=2023-05-01 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210414005130/https://archium.ateneo.edu/cgi/viewcontent.cgi?article=1042&context=history-faculty-pubs |archive-date=2021-04-14 |pages=77–78 |language=en}}</ref> {{ill|Fernando Amorsolo|en|Fernando Amorsolo}} ishte figura mbizotëruese e pikturës filipinase gjatë periudhës koloniale amerikane, i njohur për skenat e tij [[Baritore|baritore]] të fshatit filipinas.<ref name="NCCA">{{Cite web |title=Fernando C. Amorsolo |url=http://www.ncca.gov.ph/about_cultarts/cultprofile/natarts/visual/amorsolo.php |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080315060010/http://www.ncca.gov.ph/about_cultarts/cultprofile/natarts/visual/amorsolo.php |archive-date=2008-03-15 |access-date=2016-10-08 |publisher=National Commission for Culture and the Arts |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Order of National Artists: Fernando Amorsolo |url=https://ncca.gov.ph/about-culture-and-arts/culture-profile/national-artists-of-the-philippines/fernando-amorsolo/ |access-date=2022-07-15 |website=National Commission for Culture and the Arts |language=en-US}}</ref> {{ill|Victorio Edades|en|Victorio Edades}}, i njohur si babai i artit modern filipinas, e bëri popullor [[Modernizmi|modernizmin]] në Filipine gjatë viteve 1920 dhe 1930.<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Foster |first1=Simon |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=lJttBAAAQBAJ&pg=PT523 |title=The Rough Guide to the Philippines |last2=Deere |first2=Kiki |date=2014-10-01 |publisher=Rough Guides UK |location=London |isbn=978-0-241-01376-2 |language=en}}</ref>
Arkitektura tradicionale e Filipineve mbështetet në dy modele kryesore: shtëpia vendase {{lang|fil|{{ill|Bahay kubo|en|Bahay kubo}}}} dhe {{lang|fil|{{ill|Bahay na bato|en|Bahay na bato}}}}, e cila u zhvillua nën sundimin spanjoll.<ref name="Boquet-2017" />{{Rp|page={{Plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=90C4DgAAQBAJ&pg=PA438|name=438–444}}}} Disa rajone, si {{ill|Batanes|en|Batanes}}, ndryshojnë pak për shkak të klimës: si material ndërtimi përdorej guri gëlqeror dhe shtëpitë ndërtoheshin për t’u bërë ballë tajfuneve.<ref>{{Cite book |editor-last1=Yu |editor-first1=Pei-Lin |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=8DhjDwAAQBAJ&pg=PT151 |title=Relevance and Application of Heritage in Contemporary Society |editor-last2=Shen |editor-first2=Chen |editor-last3=Smith |editor-first3=George S. |date=2018 |publisher={{ill|Routledge|en|Routledge}} |location=New York |isbn=978-1-351-33296-5 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |editor-last1=Brown |editor-first1=Jessica |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=18iV522zLj0C |title=The Protected Landscape Approach: Linking Nature, Culture and Community |editor-last2=Mitchell |editor-first2=Nora J. |editor-last3=Beresford |editor-first3=Michael |date=2005 |publisher=[[Bashkimi Ndërkombëtar për Ruajtjen e Natyrës|IUCN]] |location=Gland, Switzerland |isbn=978-2-8317-0797-6 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=18iV522zLj0C&pg=PA101 101] |language=en}}</ref>
[[File:ZAMBOANGA CITY Asia's Latin City City Hall and Plaza Rizal (Ayunamiento y Plaza Rizal).jpg|thumb|Bashkia e [[Zamboanga City|Zamboangës]]<ref name="bm">{{Cite news |last1=Boncan-Buensalido |first1=Nikki |date=2015-08-10 |title=Getting to know Zamboanga |url=http://www.businessmirror.com.ph/getting-to-know-zamboanga/ |access-date=2017-03-26 |work=Business Mirror |language=en}}</ref>]]
[[Arkitektura spanjolle]] la gjurmë në planimetrinë e qyteteve, të ndërtuara rreth një [[poblacion|sheshi qendror]] ose {{lang|es|plaza mayor}}, por shumë prej ndërtesave u dëmtuan ose u shkatërruan gjatë Luftës së Dytë Botërore.<ref name=":4">{{Cite conference |last1=Cruz |first1=Geoffrey Rhoel C. |title=A Review of How Philippine Colonial Experience Influenced the Country's Approaches to Conservation of Cultural Heritage |url=https://www.dlsu.edu.ph/wp-content/uploads/pdf/conferences/arts-congress-proceedings/2019/FAC-02.pdf |access-date=2024-04-01 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210517150542/https://www.dlsu.edu.ph/wp-content/uploads/pdf/conferences/arts-congress-proceedings/2019/FAC-02.pdf |archive-date=2021-05-17 |publisher={{ill|Universiteti De La Salle|en|De La Salle University}} |book-title=Arts Congress Proceedings |volume=3 |series=9 |date=February 2019 |location=Manila, Philippines |conference=12th Arts Congress |issn=2012-0311 |at=The Philippine Built Cultural Heritage |language=en}}</ref><ref name="Ring-1996" /> Disa kisha në Filipine përshtatën [[Arkitektura baroke|arkitekturën baroke]] për t’u bërë ballë tërmeteve, duke çuar në zhvillimin e stilit {{ill|Baroku i tërmeteve|en|Earthquake Baroque}};<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Ortiz |first1=Ma. Aurora R. |last2=Erestain |first2=Teresita E. |last3=Guillermo |first3=Alice G. |last4=Montano |first4=Myrna C. |last5=Pilar |first5=Santiago A. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=T9UE6SQayrUC |title=Art: Perception & Appreciation |publisher=Goodwill Trading Co., Inc. |location=Makati, Philippines |isbn=978-971-11-0933-2 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=T9UE6SQayrUC&pg=PA287 287] |language=en}}</ref><ref name="Girard-2021">{{Cite book |last=Girard |first=Jean-Claude |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=BYZaEAAAQBAJ |title=Leandro Valencia Locsin: Filipino architect |date=2021-12-06 |publisher={{ill|Birkhäuser|en|Birkhäuser}} |location=Basel, Switzerland |isbn=978-3-0356-2093-1 |pages=[https://books.google.com/books?id=BYZaEAAAQBAJ&pg=PA23 23–25] |language=en}}</ref> katër kisha baroke janë përfshirë së bashku në listën e UNESCO-s të [[Vende të trashëgimisë botërore|vendeve të trashëgimisë botërore]].<ref name="UNESCO-BaroqueChurches">{{#invoke:cite|web|year=2010 |title=Baroque Churches of the Philippines |url=https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/677/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060210154046/https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/677/ |archive-date=2006-02-10 |access-date=2020-07-22 |website=[[Vende të trashëgimisë botërore|Qendra e Trashëgimisë Botërore e UNESCO-s]] |publisher=[[UNESCO]] |language=en}}</ref> Fortifikimet koloniale spanjolle ({{lang|es|fuerzas}}) në pjesë të ndryshme të Filipineve u projektuan kryesisht nga arkitektë misionarë dhe u ndërtuan nga gurgdhendës filipinas.<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Harrison |first1=Peter |title=Castles of God: Fortified Religious Buildings of the World |date=2004 |publisher=Boydell Press |location=Woodbridge, Suffolk, England |isbn=978-1-84383-066-5 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=g6PqNavNEdgC&pg=PA190 190] |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=g6PqNavNEdgC |language=en}}</ref> {{ill|Vigani|en|Vigan}}, në {{ill|Ilocos Surin|en|Ilocos Sur}}, njihet për shtëpitë dhe ndërtesat e stilit hispanik.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Rabang |first1=Marie Rose Q. |title=Cultural Mapping as a Tool in Heritage Conservation in a World Heritage Site: The Vigan City Experience |journal=Journal Sampurasun: Interdisciplinary Studies for Cultural Heritage |date=2015-12-04 |volume=1 |issue=1 |page=31 |doi=10.23969/sampurasun.v1i1.26 |url=https://journal.unpas.ac.id/index.php/sampurasun/article/download/26/7/58 |access-date=2023-04-19 |publisher=Research Institute of Pasundan University |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230429061850/https://journal.unpas.ac.id/index.php/sampurasun/article/download/26/7/58 |archive-date=2023-04-29 |doi-access=free |language=en}}</ref>

Sundimi amerikan solli stile të reja arkitekturore në ndërtimin e godinave qeveritare dhe të teatrove të stilit [[Art Deco]].<ref name="NCCAGovPH-Architecture">{{#invoke:cite|web|last1=Noche |first1=Manuel D. C. |title=History of Philippine Architecture |date=2015-04-14 |url=http://ncca.gov.ph/subcommissions/subcommission-on-the-arts-sca/architecture-and-allied-arts-2/history-of-philippine-architecture/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170421020700/http://ncca.gov.ph/subcommissions/subcommission-on-the-arts-sca/architecture-and-allied-arts-2/history-of-philippine-architecture/ |archive-date=2017-04-21 |access-date=2016-09-08 |publisher={{ill|Komisioni Kombëtar për Kulturën dhe Artet|en|National Commission for Culture and the Arts}} |language=en}}</ref> Gjatë periudhës amerikane nisi ndërtimi i shkollave Gabaldon,<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Ancho |first1=Inero |last2=San Juan |first2=Mark Ponce |title=Preservation Of Heritage School Buildings In The Philippines: A Case Study Of The Gabaldon Buildings |journal=Journal of Urban Culture Research |date=2021 |volume=22 |pages=106–109 |doi=10.14456/jucr.2021.8 |url=https://so04.tci-thaijo.org/index.php/JUCR/article/view/252190/171120 |access-date=2024-08-13 |issn=2408-1213 |language=en}}</ref> ndërsa në disa pjesë të [[Manila|Manilës]] dhe në {{ill|Baguio|en|Baguio}} u realizua një pjesë e planifikimit urban sipas projekteve arkitekturore dhe planeve të përgjithshme të {{ill|Daniel Burnhamit|en|Daniel Burnham}}.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Adams |first=Thomas |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=1zNNdADCYcAC |title=Outline of Town and City Planning |date=November 2004 |publisher=[[Routledge]]/Thoemmes Press |location=London |isbn=978-0-415-16094-0 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=1zNNdADCYcAC&pg=PA201 201] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |last=Kirsch |first=Scott |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=IrujEAAAQBAJ&pg=PT122 |title=American Colonial Spaces in the Philippines: Insular Empire |series=Routledge Research in Historical Geography |date=2023-02-15 |publisher=[[Routledge]] |location=Abingdon, Oxon, England |isbn=978-1-000-83977-7 |language=en}}</ref> Një pjesë e planit të Burnhamit ishte ndërtimi i godinave qeveritare që të kujtonin arkitekturën [[Arkitektura e lashtë greke|greke]] ose [[Arkitektura neoklasike|neoklasike]].<ref name="NCCAGovPH-Architecture" /><ref name="Girard-2021" /> Ndërtesa të periudhës spanjolle dhe asaj amerikane mund të shihen në {{ill|Iloilon|en|Iloilo}}, veçanërisht në [[Calle Real, Iloilo|Calle Real]].<ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|last=Salas |first=Vic |date=2022-08-09 |title=[Ilonggo Notes] A city of cultural heritage tourism zones |work={{ill|Rappler|en|Rappler}} |url=https://www.rappler.com/life-and-style/travel/ilonggo-notes-city-cultural-heritage-tourism-zones-iloilo/ |access-date=2022-11-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220809115745/https://www.rappler.com/life-and-style/travel/ilonggo-notes-city-cultural-heritage-tourism-zones-iloilo/ |archive-date=2022-08-09 |language=en}}</ref>
===Muzika dhe vallëzimi===
{{Hatnote|Artikujt kryesorë: {{ill|Muzika e Filipineve|en|Music of the Philippines}} dhe {{ill|Vallëzimi në Filipine|en|Dance in the Philippines}}}}

[[File:Tinikling.jpg|thumb|alt=Valltare me fustane shumëngjyrëshe|{{ill|Tinikling|en|Tinikling}}, një vallëzim që paraqet lëvizjet e shpejta të këmbëve të zogut ''tikling'' teksa i shmanget kurtheve të një fermeri<ref>{{Cite book |last=Akombo |first=David |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=1ByGCwAAQBAJ |title=The Unity of Music and Dance in World Cultures |date=2016-02-03 |publisher=McFarland |location=Jefferson, N.C. |isbn=978-1-4766-2269-9 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=1ByGCwAAQBAJ&pg=PA172 172] |language=en}}</ref>]]

Ekzistojnë dy lloje të {{ill|Vallëzimit popullor|en|folk dance}} filipinas, të cilat burojnë nga ndikimet tradicionale vendase dhe nga ndikimi spanjoll.<ref name="Rodell-2002" />{{rp|page={{Plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=y1CVR74_KHQC&pg=PA173|name=173}}}} Megjithëse vallëzimet vendase ishin bërë më pak popullore,<ref name="Villaruz-2006">{{Cite book |last=Villaruz |first=Basilio Esteban S. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=qLQOd-PFxe4C |title=Treading Through: 45 Years of Philippine Dance |date=2006 |publisher=University of the Philippines Press |location=Quezon City, Philippines |isbn=978-971-542-509-4 |language=en}}</ref>{{rp|page={{Plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=qLQOd-PFxe4C&pg=PA77|name=77}}}} vallëzimi popullor filloi të ringjallej gjatë viteve 1920.<ref name="Villaruz-2006" />{{rp|page={{Plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=qLQOd-PFxe4C&pg=PA82|name=82}}}} {{ill|Cariñosa|en|Cariñosa}}, një vallëzim filipinas me ndikim hispanik, konsiderohet jozyrtarisht vallëzimi kombëtar i vendit.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Rodríguez |first=José Miguel Díaz |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=emNgDwAAQBAJ&pg=PT159 |title=The Appeal of the Philippines: Spain, Cultural Representation and Politics |series=Routledge Contemporary Southeast Asia Series |date=2018 |publisher=Routledge |location=London |isbn=978-1-351-99811-6 |language=en}}</ref> Vallëzimet e njohura vendase përfshijnë {{ill|Tinikling|en|Tinikling}} dhe {{ill|Singkil|en|Singkil (Maranao dance)}}, ku shkopinjtë e bambusë përplasen në ritëm.<ref>{{Cite book |editor-last1=Parfitt |editor-first1=Clare |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=rYNSEAAAQBAJ |title=Cultural Memory and Popular Dance: Dancing to Remember, Dancing to Forget |series=Palgrave Macmillan Memory Studies |date=2021 |publisher=Springer Nature |location=Cham, Switzerland |isbn=978-3-030-71083-5 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=rYNSEAAAQBAJ&pg=PA189 189] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Namiki |first1=Kanami |title=Hybridity and National Identity: Different Perspectives of Two National Folk Dance Companies in the Philippines |journal=Asian Studies |date=2011 |volume=47 |issue=Special Issue: Cultural Hybridities of the Philippines |pages=69, 84 |url=https://asj.upd.edu.ph/mediabox/archive/ASJ-47-2011/vol-47-2011-cultural-hybridities-philippines.pdf |access-date=2023-05-10 |publisher=University of the Philippines |issn=0004-4679 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130711181559/https://asj.upd.edu.ph/mediabox/archive/ASJ-47-2011/vol-47-2011-cultural-hybridities-philippines.pdf |archive-date=2013-07-11 |language=en}}</ref> Vallëzimet e sotme variojnë nga [[Baleti|baleti]] elegant<ref>{{Cite book |editor-last1=Burridge |editor-first1=Stephanie |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=0ng5EAAAQBAJ&pg=PT164 |title=The Routledge Companion to Dance in Asia and the Pacific: Platforms for Change |date=2021-09-09 |publisher=Routledge |location=London |isbn=978-1-000-44021-8 |language=en}}</ref> deri te {{ill|breakdance|en|breakdancing}} i orientuar drejt rrugës.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Villacruz |first=Basilio Esteban S. |date=2014-07-24 |title=Philippine Dance in the American Period |url=http://www.ncca.gov.ph/about-culture-and-arts/articles-on-c-n-a/article.php?igm=1&i=117 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140724234241/http://www.ncca.gov.ph/about-culture-and-arts/articles-on-c-n-a/article.php?igm=1&i=117 |archive-date=2014-07-24 |publisher=National Commission for Culture and the Arts |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Gasgonia |first=Dennis |date=2020-12-08 |title=Olympic OK music to Pinoy breakdancers' ears — 'Chance to put PH on the map' |work=ABS-CBN News |url=https://news.abs-cbn.com/sports/12/08/20/olympic-ok-music-to-pinoy-breakdancers-ears-chance-to-put-ph-on-the-map |access-date=2023-02-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201208160028/https://news.abs-cbn.com/sports/12/08/20/olympic-ok-music-to-pinoy-breakdancers-ears-chance-to-put-ph-on-the-map |archive-date=2020-12-08 |language=en}}</ref>

Muzika e {{ill|Rondalyas|en|Rondalla}}, me instrumente tradicionale të tipit [[Mandolina|mandolinë]], ishte popullore gjatë periudhës spanjolle.<ref name="Thompson-Batalla-2018" />{{rp|page={{Plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=DmkPEAAAQBAJ&pg=PA327|name=327}}}}<ref name="KCET-MasterRondalla" /> Muzikantët e ndikuar nga spanjollët luajnë kryesisht në grupe të bazuara te {{ill|bandurria|en|bandurria}}, me kitara me 14 tela.
<ref>{{Cite encyclopedia |editor-last1=Martin |editor-first1=Andrew R. |editor-last2=Mihalka |editor-first2=Matthew |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=wvb2DwAAQBAJ |encyclopedia=Music around the World: A Global Encyclopedia |title=Philippines, Music of the |date=2020-09-08 |edition=1st |publisher=ABC-CLIO |location=Santa Barbara, Calif. |isbn=978-1-61069-499-5 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=wvb2DwAAQBAJ&pg=PA665 665] |language=en}}</ref><ref name="KCET-MasterRondalla">{{#invoke:cite|news|date=2022-05-24 |title=This Master Rondalla Musician is Preserving the Sounds of Philippine Culture in L.A. |work=KCET |url=https://www.kcet.org/shows/artbound/this-master-rondalla-musician-is-preserving-the-sounds-of-philippine-culture-in-l-a |access-date=2023-02-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220524195859/https://www.kcet.org/shows/artbound/this-master-rondalla-musician-is-preserving-the-sounds-of-philippine-culture-in-l-a |archive-date=2022-05-24 |language=en}}</ref> [[Kundiman]]i u zhvillua gjatë viteve 1920 dhe 1930.<ref name="Ellingham-1999">{{cite book |last=Ellingham |first=Mark |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=QzX8THIgRjUC |title=The Rough Guide to World Music |volume=2: Latin and North America, Caribbean, India & Pacific |series=Rough Guide Music Guides |publisher=Rough Guides |location=London |year=2000 |isbn=978-1-85828-636-5 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=QzX8THIgRjUC&pg=PA214 214] |language=en}}</ref> Periudha koloniale amerikane bëri që shumë filipinas të njiheshin me [[Kultura e Shteteve të Bashkuara|kulturën amerikane]] dhe [[Music of the United States|muzikën popullore]] të SHBA-së.<ref name="Ellingham-1999" /> [[Rock|Muzika rock]] u përhap te filipinasit gjatë viteve 1960 dhe u zhvillua në rock filipinas (ose {{ill|rock Pinoy|en|Pinoy rock}}), term që përfshin [[pop rock|rock-un pop]], [[Rock Alternative|rock-un alternativ]], [[Heavy metal|heavy metalin]], [[Punk rock|punkun]], {{ill|new wave|en|New wave music}}, {{ill|skan|en|Ska}} dhe [[Reggae|reggae-n]]. Ligji ushtarak i viteve 1970 nxiti krijimin e grupeve dhe artistëve filipinas të folk-rockut, të cilët ishin në ballë të demonstratave politike kundër diktaturës së Markosit.<ref name="Murray-2016">{{cite book |editor-last1=Murray |editor-first1=Jeremy A. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=ot2uDAAAQBAJ |title=Pop Culture in Asia and Oceania |series=Entertainment and Society around the World |editor-last2=Nadeau |editor-first2=Kathleen |date=2016-08-15 |publisher=ABC-CLIO |location=Santa Barbara, Calif. |isbn=978-1-4408-3991-7 |language=en}}</ref>{{rp|pages={{plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=ot2uDAAAQBAJ&pg=PA38|name=38–41}}}} Gjatë kësaj dekade lindën edhe {{ill|tingulli i Manilës|en|Manila sound}} dhe {{ill|Muzika Origjinale Pilipine|en|Original Pilipino Music}} (OPM).<ref name="Shunwei-2022">{{cite journal |last1=Shunwei |first1=Liu |last2=Jia |first2=Li |title=Establishment of Philippine Popular Music Industry |journal=Multicultural Education |date=2022-06-07 |volume=8 |issue=6 |pages=60, 66–67 |doi=10.5281/zenodo.6618973 |doi-access=free |url=http://ijdri.com/me/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/6.pdf |access-date=2023-04-30 |publisher=International Journal Documentation & Research Institute |language=en}}</ref><ref name="Woods-2006" />{{rp|page={{plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=2Z-n_kDTxf0C&pg=PT196|name=171}}}} {{ill|Hip-hopi filipinas|en|Filipino hip-hop}}, i cili e ka zanafillën në vitin 1979, hyri në rrymën kryesore më 1990.<ref>{{Cite encyclopedia |editor-last1=Goldsmith |editor-first1=Melissa Ursula Dawn |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=6mR2DwAAQBAJ |encyclopedia=Hip Hop around the World: An Encyclopedia |edition=Illustrated |title=The Philippines |volume=I and II: A–Z |editor-last2=Fonseca |editor-first2=Anthony J. |date=December 2018 |publisher=Greenwood |location=Santa Barbara, Calif. |isbn=978-0-313-35759-6 |pages=[https://books.google.com/books?id=6mR2DwAAQBAJ&pg=PA552 552–553] |language=en}}</ref><ref name="Murray-2016" />{{rp|pages={{plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=ot2uDAAAQBAJ&pg=PA38|name=38–41}}}} [[Karaoke]]ja është gjithashtu e përhapur.<ref>{{cite book |last=Klempe |first=Sven Hroar |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=vaV0EAAAQBAJ |title=Sound and Reason: Synesthesia as Metacognition |series=Palgrave Studies in Sound |date=2022 |publisher=Springer Nature |location=Singapore |isbn=978-981-19-2340-1 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=vaV0EAAAQBAJ&pg=PA83 83] |language=en}}</ref> Nga viti 2010 deri më 2020, {{ill|popi Pinoy|en|Pinoy pop}} (P-pop) u ndikua nga [[K-pop]] dhe {{ill|J-pop|en|J-pop}}.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|last=Newbould |first=Chris |date=2022-10-24 |title=A brief history of P-pop, from anti-Marcos messages to the mainstream and back |language=en |work=The National |url=https://www.thenationalnews.com/arts-culture/music/2022/10/24/a-brief-history-of-p-pop-from-anti-marcos-messages-to-the-mainstream-and-back/ |access-date=2023-02-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221205213311/https://www.thenationalnews.com/arts-culture/music/2022/10/24/a-brief-history-of-p-pop-from-anti-marcos-messages-to-the-mainstream-and-back/ |archive-date=2022-12-05}}</ref>

Drama teatrale i prodhuar në vend u konsolidua nga fundi i viteve 1870. Ndikimi spanjoll i asaj kohe solli shfaqjet e {{lang|es|[[zarzuela]]}}s (me muzikë)<ref name="Liu-2016">{{cite book |editor-last1=Liu |editor-first1=Siyuan |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=H1iFCwAAQBAJ |title=Routledge Handbook of Asian Theatre |series=Routledge Handbooks |date=2016 |publisher={{ill|Routledge|en|Routledge}} |location=London |isbn=978-1-317-27886-3 |pages=[https://books.google.com/books?id=H1iFCwAAQBAJ&pg=PA372 372–373] |language=en}}</ref> dhe {{lang|es|[[Comedia (play)|komedisë]]}}, të shoqëruara me vallëzim. Shfaqjet u bënë të njohura në mbarë vendin,<ref name="Villaruz-2006" />{{rp|page={{plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=qLQOd-PFxe4C&pg=PA69|name=69–70}}}} dhe u shkruan në disa gjuhë vendore.<ref name="Liu-2016" /> Ndikimi amerikan solli [[vaudeville|vodvilin]] dhe baletin.<ref name="Villaruz-2006" />{{rp|page={{plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=qLQOd-PFxe4C&pg=PA69|name=69–70}}}} Teatri [[Realism (theatre)|realist]] u bë mbizotërues gjatë shekullit XX, me pjesë që trajtonin çështje bashkëkohore politike dhe shoqërore.<ref name="Liu-2016" />
=== Letërsia ===
{{Hatnote|Artikulli kryesor: {{ill|Letërsia filipinase|en|Philippine literature}}}}

[[File:Jose Rizal full.jpg|thumb|upright|alt=fotografi e José Rizalit|Shkrimet e {{ill|José Rizal|en|José Rizal}} frymëzuan [[Revolucioni i Filipineve|Revolucionin filipinas]].]]

Letërsia filipinase përbëhet nga vepra të shkruara zakonisht në filipinisht, spanjisht ose anglisht. Disa nga veprat më të hershme të njohura u krijuan nga shekulli XVII deri në shekullin XIX.<ref>{{Cite book |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=NbY3AAAAIAAJ |title=Literaturen |date=1976 |publisher=Brill |location=Leiden, Netherlands |isbn=978-90-04-04331-2 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=NbY3AAAAIAAJ&pg=PA277 277] |language=en}}</ref> Ato përfshijnë ''{{ill|Ibong Adarna|en|Ibong Adarna}}'', një poemë epike për një zog magjik me të njëjtin emër,<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Rodriguez |first1=Eulogio Balan |title=The Adarna Bird: A Filipino Tale of Pre-Spanish Origin Incorporated in the Development of Philippine Literature, the Rapid Growth of Vernacular Belles-letters from Its Earliest Inception to the Present Day |date=1933 |publisher=General Printing Press |location=Manila, Philippines |pages=[https://web.archive.org/web/20230725001129/https://quod.lib.umich.edu/p/philamer/AJV4301.0001.001/56 51]–[https://web.archive.org/web/20230725001307/https://quod.lib.umich.edu/p/philamer/ajv4301.0001.001/57 52] |url=http://name.umdl.umich.edu/ajv4301.0001.001 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230725001440/https://quod.lib.umich.edu/cgi/t/text/text-idx?c=philamer;idno=AJV4301.0001.001 |archive-date=2023-07-25 |oclc=34358713 |via=University of Michigan Library |language=en}}</ref> si edhe ''{{ill|Florante at Laura|en|Florante at Laura}}'' të autorit tagalog {{ill|Francisco Balagtas|en|Francisco Balagtas}}.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Lumbera |first1=Bienvenido |title='Florante at Laura' and the Formalization of Tradition in Tagalog Poetry |journal=Philippine Studies |date=1967 |volume=15 |issue=4 |pages=545–575 |publisher=Ateneo de Manila University |issn=0031-7837 |jstor=42720240 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |last=Blanco |first=John D. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=sNtM4sXUgCEC |title=Frontier Constitutions: Christianity and Colonial Empire in the Nineteenth-Century Philippines |date=2009-02-24 |publisher=University of California Press |location=Berkeley, Calif. |isbn=978-0-520-94369-8 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=sNtM4sXUgCEC&pg=PA55 55] |language=en}}</ref> {{ill|José Rizal|en|José Rizal}} shkroi romanet ''{{ill|Noli Me Tángere|en|Noli Me Tángere (novel)}}'' dhe ''{{ill|El filibusterismo|en|El filibusterismo}}'',<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Bernad |first1=Miguel A. |title=Rizal in Guerrero's Translation: El Filibusterismo |journal=Philippine Studies |date=1967 |volume=15 |issue=1 |page=204 |url=http://www.philippinestudies.net/ojs/index.php/ps/article/download/2299/4425 |access-date=2023-04-30 |publisher=Ateneo de Manila University |issn=0031-7837 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171108185224/http://www.philippinestudies.net/ojs/index.php/ps/article/download/2299/4425 |archive-date=2017-11-08 |language=en}}</ref> ku të dy paraqesin padrejtësitë e sundimit kolonial spanjoll.<ref>{{Cite encyclopedia |editor-last1=Tarver |editor-first1=H. Micheal |editor-last2=Slape |editor-first2=Emily |encyclopedia=The Spanish Empire: A Historical Encyclopedia |series=Empires of the World |volume=I |edition=Illustrated |title=Philippine Revolution (1896–1898) |date=2016-07-25 |publisher=ABC-CLIO |location=Santa Barbara, Calif. |isbn=978-1-61069-422-3 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=1LCJDAAAQBAJ&pg=RA1-PA108 108] |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=1LCJDAAAQBAJ |language=en}}</ref>

{{ill|Letërsia popullore filipinase|en|Philippine folk literature}} mbeti relativisht e paprekur nga ndikimi kolonial deri në shekullin XIX, për shkak të mospërfilljes spanjolle. Shumica e veprave letrare të shtypura gjatë sundimit kolonial spanjoll kishin natyrë fetare, megjithëse elitat filipinase të njohura si {{ill|Ilustrado|en|Ilustrado}}, të cilat më vonë mësuan spanjisht, shkruan letërsi nacionaliste.<ref name="Rodell-2002" />{{rp|pages={{Plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=y1CVR74_KHQC&pg=PA59|name=59–62}}}} Ardhja e amerikanëve nisi përdorimin e anglishtes në letërsinë filipinase<ref name="Rodell-2002" />{{rp|pages={{Plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=y1CVR74_KHQC&pg=PA65|name=65–66}}}} dhe ndikoi në zhvillimin e industrisë së {{ill|komikseve filipinase|en|Philippine comics}}, e cila lulëzoi nga vitet 1920 deri në vitet 1970.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Reyes |first1=Soledad S. |author1-link=Soledad Reyes |title=The Philippine 'Komiks': Text as Containment |journal=Southeast Asian Journal of Social Science |date=1997 |volume=25 |issue=1 |pages=81–81, 85–87 |publisher=Brill |doi=10.1163/030382497X00059 |jstor=24492451 |issn=0303-8246 |oclc=9982710804 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Reyes |first1=Soledad S. |author1-link=Soledad Reyes |title=The Komiks and Retelling the Lore of the Folk |journal=Philippine Studies |date=2009 |volume=57 |issue=3 |pages=389–390 |publisher=Ateneo de Manila University |jstor=42634017 |issn=0031-7837 |oclc=9975776944 |language=en}}</ref> Në fund të viteve 1960, gjatë presidencës së Ferdinand Marcosit, letërsia filipinase u ndikua nga aktivizmi politik; shumë poetë nisën të shkruanin në tagalogisht, në përputhje me traditat gojore të vendit.<ref name="Rodell-2002" />{{rp|pages={{Plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=y1CVR74_KHQC&pg=PA69|name=69–71}}}}

{{ill|Mitologjia filipinase|en|Philippine mythology}} është përcjellë kryesisht nëpërmjet traditës gojore;<ref>{{Cite encyclopedia |editor-last1=Fee |editor-first1=Christopher R. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=kXnEDAAAQBAJ |encyclopedia=American Myths, Legends, and Tall Tales: An Encyclopedia of American Folklore |volume=I: A–F |title=Filipino American Folklore and Folktales |editor-last2=Webb |editor-first2=Jeffrey B. |date=2016-08-29 |publisher=ABC-CLIO |location=Santa Barbara, Calif. |isbn=978-1-61069-568-8 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=kXnEDAAAQBAJ&pg=PA369 369] |language=en |author-link1=Christopher R. Fee}}</ref> ndër figurat e njohura janë {{ill|Maria Makiling|en|Maria Makiling}},<ref>{{Cite book |editor-last1=Hardenberg |editor-first1=Wilko Graf von |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=8gkqDwAAQBAJ&pg=PT62 |title=The Nature State: Rethinking the History of Conservation |series=Routledge Environmental Humanities series |editor-last2=Kelly |editor-first2=Matthew |editor-last3=Leal |editor-first3=Claudia |editor-last4=Wakild |editor-first4=Emily |date=2017-07-14 |publisher={{ill|Routledge|en|Routledge}} |location=London |isbn=978-1-351-76463-6 |language=en}}</ref> Lam-ang dhe {{ill|Sarimanok|en|Sarimanok}}.<ref name="Rodell-2002" />{{rp|page={{Plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=y1CVR74_KHQC&pg=PA61|name=61}}}}<ref>{{Cite encyclopedia |last=Bane |first=Theresa |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=7PYWDAAAQBAJ |encyclopedia=Encyclopedia of Beasts and Monsters in Myth, Legend and Folklore |title=Sarimanok |date=2016-05-22 |publisher=McFarland |location=Jefferson, N.C. |isbn=978-1-4766-2268-2 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=7PYWDAAAQBAJ&pg=PA279 279] |language=en}}</ref> Vendi ka një numër të madh {{ill|poemash epike popullore filipinase|en|Philippine epic poetry}}.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Lopez |first=Mellie Leandicho |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=jGssp-oJrT8C |title=A Handbook of Philippine Folklore |date=2006 |publisher=University of the Philippines Press |location=Quezon City, Philippines |isbn=978-971-542-514-8 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=jGssp-oJrT8C&pg=PA147 147] |language=en}}</ref> Familjet e pasura mund t’i ruanin transkriptimet e poemave epike si trashëgimi familjare, sidomos në Mindanao; ''{{ill|Darangen|en|Darangen}}'', në gjuhën maranao, është një shembull i tillë.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Madale |first=Abdullah T. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=xr8_P6mJ-ZIC |title=The Maranaws, Dwellers of the Lake |date=1997 |publisher=REX Book Store, Inc. |location=Manila, Philippines |isbn=978-971-23-2174-0 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=xr8_P6mJ-ZIC&pg=PA67 67] |language=en}}</ref>

Kinematografia vendase filloi në vitin 1919 me shfaqjen e filmit të parë artistik të prodhuar nga filipinasit: {{lang|fil|{{ill|Dalagang Bukid|en|Dalagang Bukid}}}} (''Vajza nga fshati''), me regji të José Nepomuceno.<ref name="Armes-1987" /><ref name="Tofighian-2006" />{{Rp|8}} Kompanitë e prodhimit mbetën të vogla gjatë epokës së [[Filmi pa zë|filmit pa zë]], por filmat me zë dhe prodhimet më të mëdha u shfaqën në vitin 1933. Vitet e pasluftës, nga vitet 1940 deri në fillim të viteve 1960, konsiderohen periudhë kulmore për kinemanë filipinase. Gjatë dekadës 1962–1971 pati rënie të cilësisë së filmave, megjithëse industria e filmit komercial u zgjerua deri në vitet 1980.<ref name="Armes-1987" /> Ndër filmat filipinas të vlerësuar nga kritika përfshihen {{lang|fil|{{ill|Himala|en|Himala}}}} (''Mrekullia'') dhe {{lang|es|{{ill|Oro, Plata, Mata|en|Oro, Plata, Mata}}}} (''Ari, argjend, vdekje''), të dy të publikuar në vitin 1982.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|last=San Diego |first=Bayani Jr. |date=2012-08-05 |title=Restoring Himala |newspaper=Philippine Daily Inquirer |url=http://entertainment.inquirer.net/52959/restoring-himala |access-date=2012-10-29 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120806083921/http://entertainment.inquirer.net/52959/restoring-himala |archive-date=2012-08-06 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|last=Plaza |first=Gerry |date=2012-08-16 |title=May Himala! Restored film proves real global classic |work=Yahoo! |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120820024727/http://web.archive.org/web/20120820024727/http://ph.omg.yahoo.com/blogs/omgphnewsblog/may-himala-restored-film-proves-real-global-classic-013358351.html Filipinet kanë një numër të madh {{ill|stacionesh radiofonike|en|List of radio stations in the Philippines}} dhe {{ill|gazetash|en|List of newspapers in the Philippines}}.
<ref name="BBC-Philippines-Profile" /> Gazetat [[broadsheet|{{ill|gazeta broadsheet|en|Broadsheet}}]] në anglisht janë të përhapura mes drejtuesve, profesionistëve dhe studentëve.<ref name="Thompson-2003" />{{rp|pages={{plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=W1h9oF9rj-MC&pg=PA233|name=233–251}}}} Gazetat më të lira [[tabloid (newspaper format)|{{ill|gazeta tabloid|en|Tabloid (newspaper format)}}]] në tagalog, të cilat u përhapën gjatë viteve 1990, janë të popullarizuara, veçanërisht në Manila;<ref>{{cite book |last=Kusaka |first=Wataru |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=hb7WDgAAQBAJ |title=Moral Politics in the Philippines: Inequality, Democracy and the Urban Poor |series=Kyoto-CSEAS Series on Asian Studies |date=2017 |publisher=NUS Press |location=Singapore |isbn=978-981-4722-38-4 |pages=[https://books.google.com/books?id=hb7WDgAAQBAJ&pg=PA63 63–65] |language=en}}</ref> megjithatë, leximi i gazetave në tërësi është në rënie, pasi njerëzit po u drejtohen lajmeve në internet.<ref name="CNNPH-SWSFacebook" /><ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|last1=Mirasol |first1=Patricia B. |title=More smartphone-dependent Filipinos seek news on social media — Reuters report |url=https://www.bworldonline.com/world/2021/06/30/379239/more-smartphone-dependent-filipinos-seek-news-on-social-media-reuters-report/ |access-date=2023-12-21 |work=BusinessWorld |date=2021-06-30 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220524140112/https://www.bworldonline.com/world/2021/06/30/379239/more-smartphone-dependent-filipinos-seek-news-on-social-media-reuters-report/ |archive-date=2022-05-24 |language=en}}</ref> Tri gazetat kryesore për nga lexueshmëria dhe besueshmëria në shkallë vendi,<ref name="Thompson-2003" />{{rp|page={{plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=1VI9AAAAQBAJ&pg=PA233|name=233}}}} janë ''Philippine Daily Inquirer'', ''Manila Bulletin'' dhe ''The Philippine Star''.<ref>{{cite book |editor-last1=Bautista |editor-first1=Ma. Filipinët janë përdoruesit më të shumtë të internetit në botë.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|last=Lamb |first=Kate |date=2019-02-01 |title=Philippines tops world internet usage index with an average 10 hours a day |work=The Guardian |url=https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2019/feb/01/world-internet-usage-index-philippines-10-hours-a-day |access-date=2023-02-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190201095445/https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2019/02/01/world-internet-usage-index-philippines-10-hours-a-day |archive-date=2019-02-01 |language=en}}</ref> Në fillim të vitit 2021, 67 për qind e filipinasve (73,91&nbsp;milionë) kishin qasje në internet; shumica dërrmuese e tyre përdornin [[Telefoni i mençur|telefonat e mençur]].<ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|last1=Magahis |first1=Coleen |last2=Santua |first2=James |date=2021-06-18 |title=Filipinos' reliance on internet at an all-time high |work=Manila Standard |url=https://manilastandard.net/spotlight/ph-best-communication-service-providers/357427/filipinos-reliance-on-internet-at-an-all-time-high.html |access-date=2022-11-28 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210618192106/https://manilastandard.net/spotlight/ph-best-communication-service-providers/357427/filipinos-reliance-on-internet-at-an-all-time-high.html |archive-date=2021-06-18 |language=en}}</ref>
=== Kuzhina ===
{{Hatnote|Artikulli kryesor: {{ill|Kuzhina filipinase|en|Filipino cuisine}}}}

[[File:Fish sinigang.jpg|thumb|alt=Supë me copa të mëdha në një tas të bardhë|Një tas me sinigang peshku]]

Me origjinë nga popujt malajo-polinezianë, kuzhina tradicionale filipinase ka evoluar që nga shekulli XVI. Ajo u ndikua kryesisht nga kuzhinat hispanike, [[Kuzhina kino-filipinase|{{ill|kuzhina kino-filipinase|en|Filipino Chinese cuisine}}]] dhe [[Kuzhina amerikane|{{ill|kuzhina amerikane|en|American cuisine}}]], të cilat u përshtatën me shijen filipinase.<ref>{{Cite encyclopedia |last1=Roufs |first1=Timothy G. |last2=Roufs |first2=Kathleen Smyth |encyclopedia=Sweet Treats around the World: An Encyclopedia of Food and Culture |title=The Philippines |date=2014-07-29 |publisher=ABC-CLIO |location=Santa Barbara, Calif. |isbn=978-1-61069-221-2 |pages=[https://books.google.com/books?id=M_eCBAAAQBAJ&pg=PA267 267–268] |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=M_eCBAAAQBAJ |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |last=Alejandro |first=Reynaldo |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=HUaDoUF0tRwC |title=The Philippine Cookbook |date=1985 |publisher=Perigee Books |location=New York |isbn=978-0-399-51144-8 |pages=[https://books.google.com/books?id=HUaDoUF0tRwC&pg=PA12 12–14] |language=en}}</ref> Filipinët priren të parapëlqejnë shije të forta,<ref>{{Cite book |editor-last1=De Meester |editor-first1=Fabien |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=kPXurhDHsT4C |title=Wild-type Food in Health Promotion and Disease Prevention: The Columbus Concept |date=2008-01-23 |publisher=Humana Press |location=Totowa, N.J. |isbn=978-1-59745-330-1 |editor-last2=Watson |editor-first2=Ronald Ross |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=kPXurhDHsT4C&pg=PA530 530] |language=en}}</ref> të mbështetura në ndërthurje të ëmbël, të kripur dhe të thartë.<ref name="Aquino-Porter-2022">{{Cite book |editor-last1=Aquino |editor-first1=Richard S. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=ldCPEAAAQBAJ |title=Tourism in the Philippines: Applied Management Perspectives |series=Perspectives on Asian Tourism |editor-last2=Porter |editor-first2=Brooke A. |date=2022 |publisher=Springer Nature |location=Singapore |isbn=978-981-19-4497-0 |language=en}}</ref>{{Rp|page={{Plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=ldCPEAAAQBAJ&pg=PA88|name=88}}}} Ka ndryshime rajonale në mbarë vendin; orizi është burimi kryesor i [[Niseshte|niseshtesë]]<ref>{{Cite book |last=Narvaez-Soriano |first=Nora |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=pqBX_CDwVKsC proceeding |editor-last1=Howeler |editor-first=R. W. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=C4cTXJYTE4QC |title=Asian Foods: Science and Technology |editor-last2=Liu |editor-last3=Huang |editor-first2=Keshun |editor-first3=Yao-Wen |date=1999-04-05 |publisher=Technomic Publishing Co. |location=Lancaster, Pa. |isbn=978-1-56676-736-1 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=C4cTXJYTE4QC&pg=PA474 474] |language=en}}</ref> Përbërës si {{ill|kalamansi|en|Calamansi}},<ref>{{cite encyclopedia |editor-last1=Ling |editor-first1=Huping |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=0PFnBwAAQBAJ |encyclopedia=Asian American History and Culture: An Encyclopedia |title=Restaurants and Cuisine, Filipino American |editor-last2=Austin |editor-first2=Allan W. |date=2015 |publisher=Routledge |location=Abingdon, Oxon, England |isbn=978-1-317-47645-0 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=0PFnBwAAQBAJ&pg=PA303 303] |language=en |editor-link1=Huping Ling}}</ref> ''[[Ube halaya|ube]]'',<ref>{{cite book |last=Manabat |first=Rudolf Vincent T. |title=Baking Secrets |date=2020-09-14 |publisher=Anvil Publishing, Inc. |location=Mandaluyong, Philippines |isbn=978-971-27-3623-0 |language=en |chapter=Filipino Desserts |access-date=2023-03-10 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=6Ub9DwAAQBAJ |chapter-url=https://books.google.com/books?id=6Ub9DwAAQBAJ&pg=PT68}}</ref> dhe ''[[Canarium ovatum|pili]]'' përdoren në ëmbëlsirat filipinase.<ref>{{cite book |last=Duke |first=James A. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=Va3ED4zwXGIC |title=Handbook of Nuts |series=Herbal Reference Library |date=2000-11-10 |publisher=CRC Press |location=Boca Raton, Fla. |isbn=978-0-8493-3637-9 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=Va3ED4zwXGIC&pg=PA67 67] |language=en |author-link1=James A. Duke}}</ref><ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|date=2017-07-13 |title=Pili—The Delicious, Healthy Nut You've Never Heard Of |work=Vogue |url=https://www.vogue.com/article/pili-nuts-what-you-need-to-know |access-date=2023-03-10 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170714040519/https://www.vogue.com/article/pili-nuts-what-you-need-to-know |archive-date=2017-07-14 |language=en}}</ref> Përdorimi i bollshëm i [[Erëzat filipinase|erëzave]] si ''patis'', ''{{ill|bagoong|en|Bagoong}}'' dhe ''toyo'' u jep gatimeve filipinase një shije të veçantë.<ref name="Anderson-2018" /><ref name="Aquino-Porter-2022" />{{rp|page={{plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=ldCPEAAAQBAJ&pg=PA73|name=73}}}} Ka gatime vegane filipinase, ndër to laing, lumpiang gulay, ensaladang talong, turon, ginataang bilo-bilo, biko, espasol, banana cue, camote cue, taho, suman, carioca dhe lumpiang sariwa.

Ndryshe nga popujt e tjerë të Azisë Lindore dhe Juglindore, shumica e filipinasve nuk hanë me [[shkopinj|shkopinj ngrënieje]]; ata përdorin lugë dhe pirunë.{{Efn|Shumica e filipinasve përdorin lugën dhe pirunin si takëmet e zakonshme për të ngrënë, ndërsa shkopinjtë përdoren kryesisht për gatime aziatike, si ato kineze, japoneze ose koreane, veçanërisht në restorantet që shërbejnë këto gatime. Në shtëpi shkopinjtë nuk përdoren çdo ditë, ndonëse disa familje i mbajnë për qejf ose për të shijuar gatime aziatike.}}<ref>{{cite book |last1=Cruz |first1=Gemma Tulud |title=An Intercultural Theology of Migration: Pilgrims in the Wilderness |date=2010 |publisher=Brill |isbn=978-90-04-19367-3 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=NOF5DwAAQBAJ&pg=PA22 22–23] |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=NOF5DwAAQBAJ&pg=PA22 |language=en |location=Leiden, Netherlands}}</ref> Ngrënia tradicionale me duar ose gishta,<ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|last=Lowry |first=Dave |date=2016-01-06 |title=Hand-to-Mouth Combat: Experiencing a Kamayan Dinner at Hiro Asian Kitchen |work=St. Louis Magazine |url=https://www.stlmag.com/dining/hand-to-mouth-combat-experiencing-a-kamayan-dinner-at-hiro-asian-kitchen/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171107011949/https://www.stlmag.com/dining/hand-to-mouth-combat-experiencing-a-kamayan-dinner-at-hiro-asian-kitchen/ |archive-date=2017-11-07 |language=en}}</ref> e njohur si {{lang|fil|[[Kamayan|kamayan]]}}, praktikohej në zonat më pak të urbanizuara,<ref>{{cite book |last=Zibart |first=Eve |url=https://archive.org/details/ethnicfoodlovers0000ziba |title=The Ethnic Food Lover's Companion: Understanding the Cuisines of the World |publisher=Menasha Ridge Press |location=Birmingham, Ala. |year=2001 |isbn=978-0-89732-372-7 |url-access=registration |language=en}}</ref>{{rp|pages={{plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=y6vTun3i4NQC&pg=PA266|name=266–268, <!-- Nga en.wiki: Estimate --> 277}}}} por u përhap me futjen e ushqimit filipinas te të huajt dhe banorët e qyteteve.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Bender |first1=Daniel E. |last2=De Leon |first2=Adrian |title=Everybody was boodle fighting: military histories, culinary tourism, and diasporic dining |journal=Food, Culture & Society |publisher=Taylor and Francis |date=January 2018 |volume=21 |issue=1 |pages=36–37 |doi=10.1080/15528014.2017.1398469 |s2cid=158465429 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite book |last=Alejandro |first=Reynaldo G. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=IzXRAgAAQBAJ&pg=PT35 |title=Authentic Recipes from the Philippines: 81 Easy and Delicious Recipes from the Pearl of the Orient |date=2012-03-13 |publisher=Periplus Editions |location=Singapore |isbn=978-1-4629-0533-1 |language=en}}</ref>
=== Sporti dhe argëtimi ===
{{Hatnote|Artikujt kryesorë: {{ill|Basketbolli në Filipine|en|Basketball in the Philippines}}, {{ill|Lojërat tradicionale në Filipine|en|Traditional games in the Philippines}}}}

[[File:Gilas Cadets 2015 SEA Games.jpg|thumb|alt=Fotografi e ekipit, ku secili anëtar me uniformë blu mban një medalje të artë|Ekipi kombëtar filipinas i basketbollit për meshkuj feston fitimin e kampionatit në [[Basketball at the 2015 Southeast Asian Games|Lojërat e Azisë Juglindore 2015]]]]

[[Basketball in the Philippines|Basketbolli]], i luajtur në nivele amatore dhe profesionale, konsiderohet sporti më popullor i vendit.<ref>{{Cite book |editor-last1=Cho |editor-first1=Younghan |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=DYz7CwAAQBAJ |title=Modern Sports in Asia: Cultural Perspectives |series=Sport in the Global Society – Contemporary Perspectives |editor-last2=Leary |editor-first2=Charles |date=2016 |publisher={{ill|Routledge|en|Routledge}} |location=London |isbn=978-1-317-58638-8 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=DYz7CwAAQBAJ&pg=PA87 87] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite encyclopedia |last=Grasso |first=John |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=nZUarsZyzokC |encyclopedia=Historical Dictionary of Basketball |series=Historical Dictionaries of Sports |volume=2 |title=Philippines |date=2010-11-15 |publisher=Scarecrow Press |location=Lanham, Md. |isbn=978-0-8108-7506-7 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=nZUarsZyzokC&pg=PA291 291] |language=en}}</ref> Sportet e tjera popullore përfshijnë [[History of boxing in the Philippines|boksin]] dhe bilardon, të cilat kanë fituar popullaritet falë arritjeve të [[Manny Pacquiao|Meni Pakiaos (Manny Pacquiao)]] dhe [[Efren Reyes|Efren Rejesit (Efren Reyes)]].<ref name="Rood-2019" />{{Rp|page={{Plain link|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=LmmtDwAAQBAJ&pg=PA142|name=142}}}}<ref>{{Cite news |last=Himmer |first=Alastair |date=2010-06-05 |title=Pacquiao named fighter of the decade |work=[[Reuters]] |url=https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE6541BX20100605 |access-date=2020-07-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100605173159/https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE6541BX20100605 |archive-date=2010-06-05 |language=en}}</ref> [[Arnis]] është [[Filipino martial arts|arti luftarak kombëtar]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=An Act Declaring Arnis as the National Martial Art and Sport of the Philippines |chamber=RA |number=9850 |date=2009-12-11 |url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/2009/12/11/republic-act-no-9850/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170810035837/https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/2009/12/11/republic-act-no-9850/ |archive-date=2017-08-10 |access-date=2023-02-09 |publisher=Official Gazette of the Republic of the Philippines |location=Metro Manila, Philippines |language=en}}</ref> {{Lang|fil|Sabong}} (lufta e gjelave) është një argëtim popullor, sidomos mes burrave filipinas, dhe u dokumentua nga [[Ekspedita e Magelanit]].<ref>{{Cite book |editor-last1=Dundes |editor-first1=Alan |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=Wy5VqKSYt8IC |title=The Cockfight: A Casebook |publisher=[[University of Wisconsin Press]] |location=Madison, Wis. |year=1994 |isbn=978-0-299-14054-0 |pages=[https://books.google.com/books?id=Wy5VqKSYt8IC&pg=PA136 136–137] |author-link1=Alan Dundes |language=en}}</ref> [[Video games in the Philippines|Videolojërat]] dhe [[Esports in the Philippines|sportet elektronike]] po bëhen argëtime gjithnjë e më popullore,<ref>{{Cite news |last1=Lojo |first1=Michelle |title=Philippine esports gains traction in 2022 |url=https://www.philstar.com/sports/2022/12/29/2234051/philippine-esports-gains-traction-2022 |access-date=2023-04-15 |work=The Philippine Star |date=2022-12-29 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230410070659/https://www.philstar.com/sports/2022/12/29/2234051/philippine-esports-gains-traction-2022 |archive-date=2023-04-10 |language=en}}</ref><ref name="Booc-2019">{{Cite journal |last1=Booc |first1=Rahmat P. |last2=Rafaela |first2=Kimberson B. |last3=Torres |first3=Mae J. |last4=Bulawan |first4=Rina P. |last5=Jabonero |first5=Louis C. Ii |last6=Cortuna |first6=Ian Jay M. |last7=Asuncion |first7=Joel E. |title=The Traditional Filipino Games: Status Check Among Generation Z |journal=Theoretical & Applied Science |publisher=International Academy of Theoretical and Applied Sciences |date=2019-10-30 |volume=78 |issue=10 |pages=150–152, 311–315 |doi=10.15863/TAS.2019.10.78.25 |doi-access=free |language=en}}</ref> ndërsa popullariteti i [[Traditional games in the Philippines|lojërave tradicionale vendase]], si ''[[patintero]]'', ''tumbang preso'', ''luksong tinik'' dhe ''piko'', po bie mes të rinjve.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Gutierrez |first1=Ariel |last2=Guzman |first2=Neriza G. |last3=Ramos |first3=Ramilet |last4=Uylengco |first4=Jan Katherine A. |title=The Empirical Change of Playing Habits among Children |journal=International Journal of Multidisciplinary: Applied Business and Education Research |publisher=Future Science |date=2022-02-25 |volume=3 |issue=2 |pages=306–309, 311–315 |doi=10.11594/ijmaber.03.02.15 |doi-access=free |language=en}}</ref><ref name="Booc-2019" />

[[Philippines national football team|Ekipi kombëtar i futbollit për meshkuj]] ka marrë pjesë në një [[2019 AFC Asian Cup|Kupë të Azisë]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Leongson |first=Randolph B. |date=2018-03-27 |title=History made as PH Azkals advance to 2019 AFC Asian Cup after beating Tajiks |language=en |newspaper=Philippine Daily Inquirer |url=https://sports.inquirer.net/290641/ph-azkals-advance-2019-afc-asia-cup-beating-tajiks |access-date=2023-02-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201109034121/https://sports.inquirer.net/290641/ph-azkals-advance-2019-afc-asia-cup-beating-tajiks |archive-date=2020-11-09}}</ref> [[Philippines women's national football team|Ekipi kombëtar i futbollit për femra]] u kualifikua për [[2023 FIFA Women's World Cup|Kupën Botërore FIFA 2023]], pjesëmarrjen e tij të parë në [[Kupa Botërore e FIFA-s për femra|Kupën Botërore]], në janar 2022.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Morales |first=Luisa |date=2022-01-31 |title=Herstory: Filipinas outlast Chinese Taipei to seize historic Women's World Cup berth |work=The Philippine Star |url=https://www.philstar.com/sports/2022/01/31/2157582/herstory-filipinas-outlast-chinese-taipei-seize-historic-womens-world-cup-berth |access-date=2023-02-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220130170703/https://www.philstar.com/sports/2022/01/31/2157582/herstory-filipinas-outlast-chinese-taipei-seize-historic-womens-world-cup-berth |archive-date=2022-01-30 |language=en}}</ref> Filipinet kanë marrë pjesë në çdo [[Lojërat Olimpike Verore|Olimpiadë Verore]] që nga [[Philippines at the 1924 Summer Olympics|viti 1924]], përveç kohës kur mbështetën [[1980 Summer Olympics boycott|bojkotin e Lojërave Olimpike Verore 1980, të udhëhequr nga Shtetet e Bashkuara]].<ref>{{Cite encyclopedia |last1=Grasso |first1=John |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=uCN1CQAAQBAJ |encyclopedia=Historical Dictionary of the Olympic Movement |edition=Fifth |title=Philippines, The (PHI) |last2=Mallon |first2=Bill |last3=Heijmans |first3=Jeroen |date=2015-05-14 |publisher=Rowman & Littlefield |location=Lanham, Md. |isbn=978-1-4422-4860-1 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=uCN1CQAAQBAJ&pg=PA473 473] |author-link2=Bill |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=DAFJAQAAIAAJ |magazine=AF Press Clips |title=U.S. says 60 nations will join boycott |date=1980 |page=[https://books.google.com/books?id=DAFJAQAAIAAJ&pg=RA19-PA24 24] |language=en}}</ref> Ato u bënë vendi i parë tropikal që garoi në [[Lojërat olimpike dimërore|Lojërat Olimpike Dimërore]], me pjesëmarrjen e tyre të parë më [[Philippines at the 1972 Winter Olympics|1972]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Chia |first=Nicole |date=2018-02-19 |title=Winter Olympics: Even outsiders can break the ice |work=The Straits Times |url=https://www.straitstimes.com/sport/even-outsiders-can-break-the-ice |access-date=2020-07-30 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180224080645/https://www.straitstimes.com/sport/even-outsiders-can-break-the-ice |archive-date=2018-02-24 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite report |url=http://www.la84foundation.org/6oic/OfficialReports/1972/orw1972.pdf |title=The XI Olympic Winter Games; Les XI Jeux Olympiques d'hiver; Sapporo, 1972 |type=Official report |publisher=The Organizing Committee for the XIth Olympic Winter Games |year=1973 |pages=32, 145, 447 |oclc=842416 |access-date=2008-01-31 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080226202605/http://www.la84foundation.org/6oic/OfficialReports/1972/orw1972.pdf |archive-date=2008-02-26 |via=LA84 Foundation |language=en}}</ref> Në vitin 2021, Filipinet fituan medaljen e tyre të parë të artë olimpike, kur peshëngritësja [[Hidilyn Diaz|Hidilin Dias (Hidilyn Diaz)]] triumfoi në [[Lojërat Olimpike Verore 2020|Tokio]].<ref>{{Cite web |last1=Araullo |first1=Atom |author-link1=Atom Araullo |date=2021-11-04 |title=Anatomy of Philippines' first Olympic gold medal |url=https://pcij.org/article/7371/anatomy-of-philippines-first-olympic-gold-medal |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211104071057/https://pcij.org/article/7371/anatomy-of-philippines-first-olympic-gold-medal |archive-date=2021-11-04 |publisher=Philippine Center for Investigative Journalism |access-date=2023-04-23 |language=en}}</ref>
